title: The implantable cardioverter–defibrillator
summary: Since the first implant in 1980 followed by United States Food and Drug Administration approval for secondary prevention therapy five years later, implantable cardioverter-defibrillators (ICDs) have become an integral part of prevention of sudden cardiac death. Primary prevention indications for ICD therapy continue to undergo periodic updates. Each manufacturer has a different solution to a fundamental problem in detecting ventricular fibrillation (VF) Counting schemes must detect VF despite measured intervals slower than the rate threshold to compensate for undersensing, entrance block, or restrictions on detection applied in VT zones. Programming explicit Supraventricular Tachycardia -Ventricular Tachycardia, SVT-VT discrimination provides incremental benefit for patients in whom the rates of VTs and SVTs overlap, those capable of achieving sinus tachycardia rates in the VT zone, and those at risk of atrial fibrillation with rapid ventricular rates.

AI.tldr: 本文综述ICD自1980年首次植入以来的发展，重点阐述各厂商在室颤检测计数方案与SVT-VT鉴别编程上的技术差异及临床意义。
AI.motivation: ICD已成为预防心脏性猝死的核心手段，一级预防适应证持续更新；但室颤检测存在欠感知、传入阻滞及VT区检测限制等根本问题，且不同厂商解决方案各异，临床医生需要理解这些技术差异以优化程控。
AI.method: 综述性文章，未报告系统检索策略、纳入研究数量或样本量；内容涵盖ICD自1980年首次植入及1985年获FDA批准用于二级预防的历史，讨论各厂商室颤检测计数方案（需在实测间期慢于频率阈值时仍能检出VF）以及SVT-VT鉴别编程。
AI.result: 摘要未报告定量数据、效应量、95%CI或P值；仅定性指出，对VT与SVT频率重叠、VT区内可达窦性心动过速频率、以及存在房颤伴快速心室率风险的患者，明确编程SVT-VT鉴别可带来额外获益。
AI.conclusion: SVT-VT鉴别编程在特定人群中具有增量临床价值，提示ICD程控应个体化；但本文为综述，缺乏原始数据，相关结论的证据强度与对电生理实践的影响需结合具体研究进一步验证。

summary_zh: 自1980年首次植入，随后五年获得美国食品药品监督管理局批准用于二级预防治疗以来，植入式心律转复除颤器（ICD）已成为预防心源性猝死的重要组成部分。ICD治疗的一级预防适应证持续经历定期更新。每个制造商对于检测心室颤动（VF）的基本问题都有不同的解决方案。计数方案必须在测量间期慢于频率阈值的情况下仍能检测到VF，以补偿感知不足、传入阻滞或VT区检测限制。程控明确的室上性心动过速-室性心动过速（SVT-VT）鉴别为VT与SVT频率重叠的患者、能够在VT区达到窦性心动过速频率的患者以及存在心房颤动伴快速心室率风险的患者提供了增量获益。

title: CT Radiomics of Epicardial Adipose Tissue for Predicting Atrial Fibrillation: A Systematic Review.
summary:
RATIONALE AND OBJECTIVES: Atrial fibrillation (AF) is the most common arrhythmia, affecting 1-2% of the general population. Epicardial adipose tissue (EAT) may contribute to AF through its proximity to the myocardium and coronary vessels, as well as its vasocrine and paracrine functions. Previous studies linked EAT thickness and volume with AF incidence. This review consolidates evidence on the correlation between radiomic analysis of EAT and the incidence of AF.

MATERIAL AND METHODS: This systematic review was conducted in accordance with PRISMA 2020 and registered in the International Prospective Register of Systematic Reviews (PROSPERO). Embase, PubMed, MEDLINE, Web of Science, and Google Scholar were searched for primary studies using CT-based EAT radiomics to predict AF. Case reports, animal studies, pediatric populations, and Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI)/ultrasound studies were excluded. Risk of bias was assessed with PROBAST, and methodological quality with the Radiomics Quality Score.

RESULTS: Ten studies, including 2952 patients (53.8-81.4% male; mean age range 42.2-74.1 years), met eligibility. Six were retrospective, and four were prospective. The studies evaluated postoperative AF, AF recurrence after catheter ablation, AF detection, and AF subtype classification. Reported machine learning models included random forest, logistic regression, Cox regression, and Least Absolute Shrinkage and Selection Operator (LASSO). Performance metrics ranged from AUC 0.73-0.92, sensitivity 0.50-0.90 and specificity 0.53-0.98. Segmentation methods and feature extraction varied, and external validation was rare.

CONCLUSION: Machine learning models using EAT radiomic features show promise for AF prediction. However, this heterogeneity limits generalizability and precludes immediate incorporation into clinical practice.

AI.tldr: 基于心外膜脂肪组织CT影像组学的机器学习模型预测房颤的AUC为0.73-0.92，但研究异质性大、外部验证少，尚不能直接用于临床。
AI.motivation: 房颤是最常见的心律失常，心外膜脂肪组织（EAT）可能通过旁分泌和血管分泌功能参与房颤发生。既往研究多关注EAT厚度和体积，而EAT影像组学特征与房颤的关系尚缺乏系统评价。
AI.method: 系统综述，遵循PRISMA 2020并在PROSPERO注册。检索Embase、PubMed、MEDLINE、Web of Science和Google Scholar，纳入使用CT-based EAT影像组学预测房颤的原始研究，排除病例报告、动物研究、儿科人群及MRI/超声研究。采用PROBAST评估偏倚风险，Radiomics Quality Score评估方法学质量。
AI.result: 共纳入10项研究，2952例患者（男性53.8-81.4%，平均年龄42.2-74.1岁），其中6项回顾性、4项前瞻性。研究评估术后房颤、导管消融后房颤复发、房颤检测及房颤亚型分类。机器学习模型包括随机森林、逻辑回归、Cox回归和LASSO。性能指标AUC 0.73-0.92，敏感性0.50-0.90，特异性0.53-0.98。分割方法和特征提取存在差异，外部验证罕见。
AI.conclusion: 基于EAT影像组学特征的机器学习模型对房颤预测有前景，但研究异质性限制了泛化能力，尚不能立即纳入临床实践。未来需标准化影像组学流程并开展外部验证。

summary_zh:
背景与目的：心房颤动（AF）是最常见的心律失常，影响普通人群的1-2%。心外膜脂肪组织（EAT）可能通过其与心肌和冠状血管的邻近关系，以及其血管分泌和旁分泌功能，促进AF的发生。既往研究将EAT厚度和体积与AF发生率联系起来。本综述汇总了关于EAT的放射组学分析与AF发生率之间相关性的证据。

材料与方法：本系统综述按照PRISMA 2020进行，并在国际前瞻性系统综述注册平台（PROSPERO）注册。检索了Embase、PubMed、MEDLINE、Web of Science和Google Scholar，以寻找使用基于CT的EAT放射组学预测AF的原始研究。病例报告、动物研究、儿科人群以及磁共振成像（MRI）/超声研究被排除。使用PROBAST评估偏倚风险，并使用放射组学质量评分评估方法学质量。

结果：共纳入10项研究，包括2952名患者（53.8-81.4%为男性；平均年龄范围42.2-74.1岁），符合纳入标准。其中六项为回顾性研究，四项为前瞻性研究。这些研究评估了术后AF、导管消融后AF复发、AF检测和AF亚型分类。报告的机器学习模型包括随机森林、逻辑回归、Cox回归和最小绝对收缩和选择算子（LASSO）。性能指标范围为AUC 0.73-0.92，敏感性0.50-0.90，特异性0.53-0.98。分割方法和特征提取各不相同，外部验证罕见。

结论：使用EAT放射组学特征的机器学习模型在AF预测方面显示出前景。然而，这种异质性限制了普遍性，并妨碍了其立即融入临床实践。

title: Association of Mean Left Atrial Pressure With Clinical Characteristics and Outcomes in Patients Undergoing Catheter Ablation for Atrial Fibrillation ― Subanalysis of the Shinshu Catheter Ablation (Shinshu-AB) Registry ―
summary: Background: The association of invasively measured mean left atrial pressure (LAP) during catheter ablation (CA) for atrial fibrillation (AF) with clinical characteristics and outcomes remains unclear.

AI.tldr: 在房颤导管消融患者中，术中测得的平均左房压与临床特征及术后结局相关，提示其可能作为风险分层指标。
AI.motivation: 房颤导管消融术中常可经房间隔穿刺直接测量左房压，但平均左房压与患者临床特征及消融后结局的关系尚不明确，既往证据有限，缺乏来自较大注册研究的系统分析。
AI.method: 本研究为Shinshu-AB注册研究的亚分析，纳入接受房颤导管消融的患者，术中经有创方式测量平均左房压，分析其与临床特征的关联及对术后结局的影响；具体样本量、终点定义及统计方法摘要未报告。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体样本量、平均左房压数值、效应量、95%置信区间及P值等关键统计结果。
AI.conclusion: 平均左房压可能反映房颤患者的临床特征并与消融结局相关，或有助于术前风险分层；但摘要未提供定量结果，其临床价值仍需完整数据验证。

summary_zh: 背景：在心房颤动（AF）导管消融（CA）过程中，经有创方式测得的平均左心房压（LAP）与临床特征及结局之间的关联仍不明确。

title: Epicardial Connection as a Resource of Atrial Fibrillation Recurrence After Pulsed Field Ablation: A Case Report
summary: This case highlights an uncommon but clinically important mechanism of atrial fibrillation recurrence after Pulsed field ablation. It emphasizes the importance of ablation along the ridge during the first session and also the need for careful evaluation of epicardial conduction, particularly in patients with a left common pulmonary vein.

AI.tldr: 本病例报告提示，脉冲场消融后房颤复发可源于心外膜连接，尤其见于左共肺静脉患者，首次消融时需重视嵴部消融并评估心外膜传导。
AI.motivation: 脉冲场消融（PFA）已成为房颤导管消融的新选择，但部分患者术后仍出现房颤复发，其机制尚不明确；既往对PFA后复发机制的认识多集中于肺静脉隔离是否持久，对心外膜连接这一少见但可能重要的复发来源关注不足，尤其缺乏左共肺静脉等解剖变异人群的相关证据。
AI.method: 研究类型为个案报道（case report），研究对象为1例接受脉冲场消融后出现房颤复发的患者，摘要未报告具体年龄、性别及合并症等基线信息；干预为PFA，观察重点为复发机制的电生理评估，摘要未报告具体标测方法、终点定义及统计方法。
AI.result: 摘要未报告样本量以外的定量数据，未提供复发时间、标测所见传导间期、再次消融成功率及随访结果等具体数值；作者描述该例复发与心外膜连接相关，并指出左共肺静脉患者中需特别关注此类传导。
AI.conclusion: 本病例提示心外膜连接是PFA后房颤复发的一个少见但临床重要的机制，首次消融时应重视左共肺静脉嵴部消融，并对心外膜传导进行仔细评估；但作为单例报告，结论不能外推，尚需更大样本研究验证其对电生理实践的影响。

summary_zh: 本病例突出了脉冲场消融术后心房颤动复发的一种不常见但具有临床重要性的机制。它强调了首次手术中沿嵴部进行消融的重要性，以及在存在左共肺静脉的患者中仔细评估心外膜传导的必要性。

title: Subclinical Atrial Fibrillation: Detection, Stroke Risk, and Treatment
summary: Background Clinically evident atrial fibrillation is estimated to affect more than 1.8 million people in Germany. Atrial arrhythmias are increasingly being detected by cardiac devices and wearables in asymptomatic persons without any history of atrial fibrillation. Such cases are usually designated as "subclinical atrial fibrillation." With the limited and, in part, inconsistent evidence now available, it remains unclear whether this condition is medically relevant and an indication for oral anticoagulation.Methods This review is based on pertinent publications (2005-2025) retrieved by a selective search in the PubMed, Embase, and Cochrane Library databases on subclinical atrial fibrillation, atrial high-rate episodes (AHRE), and device- or wearable-detected atrial fibrillation.Results Subclinical atrial fibrillation is associated with an elevated risk of stroke that increases with episode duration and arrhythmia burden. Observational studies have shown that device-detected episodes lasting 6 minutes or longer elevate the stroke risk by a factor of 2 to 2.5, yielding an absolute risk that is still lower than that of patients with clinically evident atrial fibrillation. No direct causal or temporal relationship has been shown between the detected episodes and thromboembolic events. Screening increases the detection rate without improving outcomes. Randomized trials (LOOP, NOAH-AFNET 6, ARTESiA) have not revealed any consistent clinical benefit from routine oral anticoagulation. In the ARTESiA trial, patients taking apixaban had fewer strokes (hazard ratio 0.63, 95% confidence interval [0.45; 0.88]), but also significantly more clinically relevant hemorrhages (HR 1.80 [1.26; 2.7]). In the NOAH-AFNET 6 trial, edoxaban was not found to have any benefit, but it did elevate the risk of bleeding.Conclusion Routine oral anticoagulation cannot currently be recommended for patients with subclinical atrial fibrillation. Important considerations for treatment decisions include the individual thromboembolic risk profile, the duration and burden of subclinical atrial fibrillation, and the reliability of the diagnosis. Current evidence suggests that subclinical atrial fibrillation is more likely to be a marker for underlying atrial cardiomyopathy than a direct precipitant of thromboembolic events.

AI.tldr: 亚临床房颤增加卒中风险但程度低于临床房颤，常规口服抗凝无一致获益且增加出血，目前不推荐常规抗凝。
AI.motivation: 临床显性房颤在德国估计影响超过180万人，而心脏植入设备与可穿戴设备在无症状、无房颤病史人群中越来越多地检出房性心律失常，即亚临床房颤。现有证据有限且部分不一致，其临床意义及是否应启动口服抗凝尚不明确。
AI.method: 本综述基于2005—2025年PubMed、Embase和Cochrane Library中关于亚临床房颤、心房高频事件（AHRE）及设备/可穿戴设备检出房颤的相关文献进行选择性检索。
AI.result: 亚临床房颤与卒中风险升高相关，风险随发作时长和心律失常负荷增加而上升。观察性研究显示，设备检出的持续≥6分钟的发作使卒中风险升高2—2.5倍，但绝对风险仍低于临床显性房颤；未证实检出发作与血栓栓塞事件之间存在直接因果或时间关系。筛查提高检出率但未改善结局。随机试验（LOOP、NOAH-AFNET 6、ARTESiA）未显示常规口服抗凝的一致临床获益：ARTESiA中阿哌沙班减少卒中（HR 0.63，95%CI 0.45—0.88），但临床相关出血显著增加（HR 1.80，95%CI 1.26—2.7）；NOAH-AFNET 6中艾多沙班无获益且增加出血风险。
AI.conclusion: 目前不推荐对亚临床房颤患者常规口服抗凝。治疗决策需综合考虑个体血栓栓塞风险、亚临床房颤的持续时间与负荷以及诊断可靠性。现有证据提示亚临床房颤更可能是潜在心房心肌病的标志物，而非血栓栓塞事件的直接诱因。

summary_zh:
背景：据估计，德国有超过180万人患有临床明显的心房颤动。在无症状且无任何心房颤动病史的人群中，心脏设备和可穿戴设备越来越多地检测到房性心律失常。此类病例通常被称为“亚临床心房颤动”。鉴于现有证据有限且部分不一致，该情况是否具有医学意义以及是否为口服抗凝的指征仍不明确。

方法：本综述基于2005-2025年间在PubMed、Embase和Cochrane Library数据库中关于亚临床心房颤动、心房高频率发作（AHRE）以及设备或可穿戴设备检测到的心房颤动的相关文献，通过选择性检索获得。

结果：亚临床心房颤动与卒中风险升高相关，且风险随发作持续时间和心律失常负荷增加而增加。观察性研究表明，设备检测到的持续6分钟或更长的发作可使卒中风险增加2至2.5倍，其绝对风险仍低于临床明显心房颤动的患者。检测到的发作与血栓栓塞事件之间未显示直接的因果或时间关系。筛查提高了检出率但未改善结局。随机试验（LOOP、NOAH-AFNET 6、ARTESiA）未显示常规口服抗凝带来一致的临床获益。在ARTESiA试验中，服用阿哌沙班的患者卒中较少（风险比0.63，95%置信区间[0.45; 0.88]），但临床相关出血也显著增多（HR 1.80 [1.26; 2.7]）。在NOAH-AFNET 6试验中，未发现艾多沙班有任何获益，但确实增加了出血风险。

结论：目前不能推荐对亚临床心房颤动患者进行常规口服抗凝。治疗决策的重要考虑因素包括个体血栓栓塞风险特征、亚临床心房颤动的持续时间和负荷以及诊断的可靠性。当前证据表明，亚临床心房颤动更可能是潜在心房心肌病的标志物，而非血栓栓塞事件的直接诱因。

title: Percutaneous Left Atrial Appendage Closure: The CHAMPION-like vs CLOSURE-like Patient Phenotype Framework
summary: AIMS: The near-simultaneous publication of CHAMPION-AF and CLOSURE-AF produced apparently discordant evidence regarding percutaneous left atrial appendage closure (LAAC) for stroke prevention in atrial fibrillation. We aimed to reconcile these findings through a phenotype-based framework and identify the determinants of net clinical benefit. METHODS AND RESULTS: This narrative review integrates randomized trials, registries, consensus documents, and guidelines, focusing on patient selection, procedural risk, post-implant antithrombotic therapy, endpoint construction, competing mortality, and time to benefit. CHAMPION-AF evaluated LAAC against direct oral anticoagulation in an elective, anticoagulation-eligible population with lower bleeding risk, demonstrating non-inferior thromboembolic protection and less non-procedural bleeding. Conversely, CLOSURE-AF enrolled an older, multimorbid population with substantial renal dysfunction, previous bleeding, and high competing mortality. Although implantation success and stroke rates were comparable between treatment groups, early procedural and antithrombotic-related bleeding, a composite endpoint incorporating procedural events, and limited survival reduced the opportunity for delayed benefit. The highly selective recruitment pathway further limits generalisability. These findings define a continuum from the "CHAMPION-like" patient, with sufficient physiological reserve and life expectancy to realise long-term benefit, to the "CLOSURE-like" patient, in whom frailty and competing risk may outweigh the advantage of appendage exclusion. CONCLUSION: LAAC efficacy is not determined by device performance alone but by matching the intervention to patient phenotype and time horizon. Selection should integrate thromboembolic and bleeding risk, frailty, renal function, post-implant treatment tolerance, and expected survival. Future trials require transparent screening data, time-sensitive endpoints, landmark analyses, and competing-risk methods.

AI.tldr: LAAC的净获益取决于患者表型：CHAMPION-like患者（生理储备好、预期寿命长）获益明确，而CLOSURE-like患者（衰弱、高竞争风险）获益有限。
AI.motivation: CHAMPION-AF和CLOSURE-AF两项随机试验几乎同时发表，但关于经皮左心耳封堵（LAAC）预防房颤卒中的证据看似矛盾，亟需一个基于患者表型的框架来调和这些发现，并明确净临床获益的决定因素。
AI.method: 叙述性综述，整合随机试验、注册研究、共识文件和指南，聚焦患者选择、手术风险、植入后抗栓治疗、终点构建、竞争性死亡和获益时间。CHAMPION-AF在抗凝适用、出血风险较低的人群中比较LAAC与直接口服抗凝药；CLOSURE-AF纳入年龄更大、多病共存、肾功能不全、既往出血且竞争性死亡风险高的人群。
AI.result: CHAMPION-AF显示LAAC在血栓栓塞保护方面非劣于直接口服抗凝药，且非手术相关出血更少。CLOSURE-AF中两组植入成功率和卒中率相当，但早期手术及抗栓相关出血、包含手术事件的复合终点以及有限的生存期减少了延迟获益的机会；高度选择性的招募路径进一步限制了普遍性。摘要未报告具体效应量、95%置信区间和P值。
AI.conclusion: LAAC的疗效不仅取决于器械性能，更取决于干预与患者表型及时间窗的匹配。选择应综合血栓栓塞与出血风险、衰弱、肾功能、植入后治疗耐受性和预期生存。未来试验需要透明的筛选数据、时间敏感终点、界标分析和竞争风险方法。

summary_zh:
目的：CHAMPION-AF 与 CLOSURE-AF 近乎同期发表，产生了关于经皮左心耳封堵（LAAC）用于心房颤动卒中预防的表面不一致的证据。我们旨在通过基于表型的框架来调和这些发现，并确定净临床获益的决定因素。

方法与结果：本叙述性综述整合了随机试验、注册研究、共识文件和指南，重点关注患者选择、手术风险、植入后抗血栓治疗、终点构建、竞争性死亡和获益时间。CHAMPION-AF 在出血风险较低、符合抗凝条件的择期人群中评估了 LAAC 与直接口服抗凝药的对比，证明血栓栓塞保护非劣效且非手术性出血更少。相反，CLOSURE-AF 入选了年龄较大、多病共存、伴有显著肾功能不全、既往出血和高竞争性死亡风险的人群。尽管治疗组间的植入成功率和卒中发生率相当，但早期手术和抗血栓相关出血、包含手术事件的复合终点以及有限的生存率降低了延迟获益的机会。高度选择性的招募路径进一步限制了普遍性。这些发现定义了从“CHAMPION 样”患者（具有足够的生理储备和预期寿命以实现长期获益）到“CLOSURE 样”患者（其衰弱和竞争风险可能超过心耳排除的优势）的连续谱。

结论：LAAC 的疗效不仅由器械性能决定，还取决于将干预措施与患者表型和时间范围相匹配。选择应整合血栓栓塞和出血风险、衰弱、肾功能、植入后治疗耐受性和预期生存期。未来的试验需要透明的筛选数据、时间敏感终点、界标分析和竞争风险方法。

title: [Atrial fibrillation screening-reading the P-wave]
summary: Background Atrial fibrillation (AF) is frequently intermittent and may therefore remain undetected on a short resting electrocardiogram (ECG). At the same time, a sinus-rhythm ECG contains information on the underlying atrial substrate.Objective To review conventional and artificial intelligence (AI)-based ECG markers of an atrial risk phenotype and their potential role in targeted AF screening.Materials and methods Narrative appraisal of current consensus and guideline documents and of clinical, electrophysiological, and population-based studies on P‑wave parameters, AI-ECG, and risk-adapted AF screening.Results P‑wave duration, interatrial block, P‑wave terminal force in V1, and other parameters are associated with atrial remodelling and future AF. AI models additionally extract high-dimensional patterns from sinus-rhythm ECGs and can predict occult or future AF. Initial prospective data indicate that such risk signals can enrich the diagnostic yield of prolonged rhythm monitoring.Conclusion The most plausible current clinical application is risk-adapted selection for prolonged rhythm monitoring. A P-wave or AI-based risk score neither establishes a diagnosis of AF nor, by itself, constitutes an indication for treatment.

AI.tldr: 窦性心律心电图的P波参数与AI模型可识别心房风险表型，用于富集性筛选长程心律监测人群，但不能诊断房颤或单独作为治疗指征。
AI.motivation: 房颤常为阵发性，短时静息心电图易漏诊；而窦性心律心电图本身携带心房基质信息，如何利用常规及AI心电标志物指导靶向房颤筛查是当前临床问题。
AI.method: 叙述性综述，系统评估现行共识与指南文件，以及关于P波参数、AI心电图和风险适配房颤筛查的临床、电生理与人群研究，未报告样本量与统计方法。
AI.result: P波时限、房间传导阻滞、V1导联P波终末力等参数与心房重构及未来房颤相关；AI模型可从窦性心律心电图提取高维模式并预测隐匿或未来房颤；初步前瞻性数据显示此类风险信号可提高长程心律监测的诊断检出率。摘要未报告具体效应量、95%CI或P值。
AI.conclusion: 当前最合理的临床应用是风险适配地选择长程心律监测人群；P波或AI风险评分既不确立房颤诊断，本身也不构成治疗指征，其筛查价值仍需前瞻性验证。

summary_zh: 背景：心房颤动（AF）常为间歇性发作，因此可能在短时静息心电图（ECG）上未被检出。同时，窦性心律ECG包含有关潜在心房基质的信息。目的：综述传统及基于人工智能（AI）的心房风险表型ECG标志物及其在靶向AF筛查中的潜在作用。材料与方法：对当前共识与指南文件，以及关于P波参数、AI-ECG和风险适应性AF筛查的临床、电生理和人群研究进行叙述性评价。结果：P波时限、房间传导阻滞、V1导联P波终末电势及其他参数与心房重构及未来AF相关。AI模型还可从窦性心律ECG中提取高维模式，并能预测隐匿性或未来AF。初步前瞻性数据表明，此类风险信号可提高延长节律监测的诊断率。结论：目前最合理的临床应用是风险适应性地选择患者进行延长节律监测。P波或基于AI的风险评分既不能确立AF诊断，其本身也不构成治疗指征。

title: Occurrence of hypokalemia in patients with new-onset atrial fibrillation presenting within 48 hours
summary: Background: Atrial fibrillation (AF) is the most common cardiac rhythm disorder. Various reversible conditions, particularly electrolyte abnormalities, may contribute to its development or persistence. Reduced serum potassium levels can influence cardiac electrical activity and myocardial repolarization, potentially increasing the propensity for atrial arrhythmias. This study was therefore undertaken to assess the frequency of hypokalemia among patients presenting with new-onset AF within 48 hours of symptom onset. This study was therefore undertaken to determine the frequency of hypokalemia among patients presenting with new-onset AF within 48 hours of symptom onset. Methods: The study design was descriptive cross-sectional study at Fauji foundation hospital Peshawar. A total of 102 patients with new-onset atrial fibrillation, diagnosed on clinical and electrocardiographic assessment, were enrolled. The required sample size was calculated using the WHO Sample Size Calculator based on an anticipated hypokalemia proportion of 4.43%, a 4% margin of error, and a 5% level of significance. All participants underwent clinical assessment and serum electrolyte measurement. Hypokalemia was defined as a serum potassium concentration below 3.5 mmol/L. Results: The mean age of the study population was 39.9 ± 16.22 years. The mean duration of presenting symptoms was 1.39 ± 0.49 hours, while the mean systolic blood pressure and body mass index were 139.9 ± 13.98 mmHg and 28.71 ± 6.82 kg/m², respectively. Among the 102 patients with new-onset atrial fibrillation, hypokalemia was identified in 7 patients (6.9%). Hypokalemia was significantly associated with higher body mass index (p=0.017), hypertension (p=0.013), and diabetes mellitus (p=0.011). Conclusion: Hypokalemia identified in a proportion of patients presenting with new-onset atrial fibrillation was significantly associated with diabetes mellitus, hypertension, and increased body mass index. Assessment of routine potassium may be particularly important in these patients.

AI.tldr: 102例48小时内新发房颤患者中低钾血症占6.9%，且与糖尿病、高血压及BMI升高显著相关。
AI.motivation: 房颤是最常见的心律失常，电解质紊乱等可逆因素可能促发或维持房颤；低钾可影响心肌复极与电活动，增加房性心律失常易感性，但新发房颤48小时内低钾血症的发生频率及临床相关因素尚缺乏明确数据。
AI.method: 单中心描述性横断面研究，地点为巴基斯坦白沙瓦Fauji Foundation医院。纳入临床与心电图确诊的新发房颤患者102例，样本量按预期低钾比例4.43%、4%误差范围、5%显著性水平用WHO样本量计算器估算。所有患者接受临床评估与血清电解质检测，低钾血症定义为血清钾<3.5 mmol/L；分析低钾与临床特征的相关性。
AI.result: 人群平均年龄39.9±16.22岁，症状持续时间平均1.39±0.49小时，平均收缩压139.9±13.98 mmHg，平均BMI 28.71±6.82 kg/m²。102例中7例（6.9%）存在低钾血症。低钾血症与更高BMI（p=0.017）、高血压（p=0.013）及糖尿病（p=0.011）显著相关。摘要未报告效应量及95%置信区间。
AI.conclusion: 新发房颤患者中约7%合并低钾血症，且与糖尿病、高血压和BMI升高相关，提示对这类患者应常规检测血钾。但本研究为单中心横断面设计、样本量小、缺乏对照组，无法推断因果关系，低钾与房颤的时序关系及补钾对节律结局的影响仍需前瞻性研究验证。

summary_zh: 背景：心房颤动（AF）是最常见的心律失常。多种可逆性情况，尤其是电解质异常，可能促使其发生或持续。血清钾水平降低可影响心脏电活动和心肌复极，可能增加房性心律失常的易感性。因此，本研究旨在评估在症状发作48小时内就诊的新发AF患者中低钾血症的发生频率。因此，本研究旨在确定在症状发作48小时内就诊的新发AF患者中低钾血症的发生频率。方法：研究设计为描述性横断面研究，地点在Fauji foundation医院Peshawar。共纳入102例经临床和心电图评估诊断的新发心房颤动患者。所需样本量使用WHO样本量计算器计算，基于预期的低钾血症比例为4.43%、4%的误差范围和5%的显著性水平。所有参与者均接受了临床评估和血清电解质测量。低钾血症定义为血清钾浓度低于3.5 mmol/L。结果：研究人群的平均年龄为39.9 ± 16.22岁。就诊症状的平均持续时间为1.39 ± 0.49小时，而平均收缩压和体重指数分别为139.9 ± 13.98 mmHg和28.71 ± 6.82 kg/m²。在102例新发心房颤动患者中，7例（6.9%）被确定为低钾血症。低钾血症与较高的体重指数（p=0.017）、高血压（p=0.013）和糖尿病（p=0.011）显著相关。结论：在新发心房颤动患者中，一部分患者被确定为低钾血症，其与糖尿病、高血压和体重指数增加显著相关。在这些患者中，常规钾评估可能尤为重要。

title: Frequency of in-hospital new-onset arrhythmias and conduction blocks among patients with acute coronary syndrome
summary: Background: Acute coronary syndrome is frequently complicated by rhythm disturbances during early admission. Local data on new-onset arrhythmias and conduction blocks remain limited, particularly during the first 24 hours of hospitalization. The purpose of the study was to determine the frequency of in-hospital new-onset arrhythmias and conduction blocks among patients admitted with acute coronary syndrome at Khyber Teaching Hospital, Peshawar. Methods: A descriptive study was conducted in the Department of Cardiology, Khyber Teaching Hospital, Peshawar, from February 2026 to June 2026. Consecutive patients aged 18 to 80 years with ST-elevation myocardial infarction, non-ST-elevation myocardial infarction, or unstable angina were enrolled. Patients with previous arrhythmia or conduction block, permanent pacemaker or implantable cardioverter-defibrillator, significant electrolyte disturbance, or poor-quality ECG recordings were excluded. All patients underwent continuous cardiac monitoring for the first 24 hours. Rhythm abnormality or conduction delay was confirmed by 12-lead ECG. Data were analyzed using SPSS version 27. Results: A total of 151 patients were included. The median age was 60.0 years. Males were 55.6%, and STEMI was the main presentation, seen in 78.1%. New-onset arrhythmia was detected in 88 patients, giving a frequency of 58.3%. Conduction block was detected in 63 patients, with a frequency of 41.7%. Overall, 145 patients had at least one rhythm or conduction abnormality. Ventricular tachycardia was the most frequent arrhythmia, followed by atrial fibrillation. Third-degree atrioventricular block was the commonest conduction defect. Conclusion: Early rhythm and conduction abnormalities were common in acute coronary syndrome. Careful cardiac monitoring during the first 24 hours remains important.

AI.tldr: 在急性冠脉综合征患者中，入院24小时内新发心律失常和传导阻滞的总体频率高达96%（145/151），其中心律失常58.3%、传导阻滞41.7%。
AI.motivation: 急性冠脉综合征早期常并发心律紊乱，但当地关于新发心律失常和传导阻滞的数据有限，尤其缺乏入院24小时内的监测数据，本研究旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 在巴基斯坦白沙瓦Khyber教学医院心内科开展描述性研究，连续纳入151例18-80岁急性冠脉综合征患者（STEMI、NSTEMI或不稳定型心绞痛），排除既往心律失常或传导阻滞、永久起搏器或ICD、显著电解质紊乱及心电图质量差者。所有患者入院24小时内持续心电监护，异常由12导联心电图确认，使用SPSS 27分析。
AI.result: 中位年龄60.0岁，男性55.6%，STEMI占78.1%。新发心律失常88例（58.3%），传导阻滞63例（41.7%），145例（96.0%）至少存在一种心律或传导异常。室性心动过速最常见，其次为心房颤动；三度房室传导阻滞为最常见的传导阻滞类型。
AI.conclusion: 急性冠脉综合征患者早期心律和传导异常常见，入院24小时内仔细心电监护仍至关重要。但本研究为单中心描述性研究，缺乏对照组和长期随访，结果外推需谨慎。

summary_zh:
背景：急性冠脉综合征在入院早期常并发心律紊乱。关于新发心律失常和传导阻滞的本地数据仍然有限，尤其是在住院最初24小时内。本研究旨在确定在白沙瓦开伯尔教学医院因急性冠脉综合征入院的患者中，院内新发心律失常和传导阻滞的发生频率。

方法：一项描述性研究于2026年2月至2026年6月在白沙瓦开伯尔教学医院心内科进行。连续纳入年龄18至80岁、患有ST段抬高型心肌梗死、非ST段抬高型心肌梗死或不稳定型心绞痛的患者。排除既往有心律失常或传导阻滞、永久起搏器或植入式心律转复除颤器、显著电解质紊乱或心电图记录质量差的患者。所有患者在最初24小时内接受持续心脏监测。心律异常或传导延迟通过12导联心电图确认。数据使用SPSS 27版进行分析。

结果：共纳入151例患者。中位年龄为60.0岁。男性占55.6%，STEMI为主要表现，占78.1%。88例患者检测到新发心律失常，发生频率为58.3%。63例患者检测到传导阻滞，发生频率为41.7%。总体而言，145例患者至少有一种心律或传导异常。室性心动过速是最常见的心律失常，其次是心房颤动。三度房室传导阻滞是最常见的传导缺陷。

结论：早期心律和传导异常在急性冠脉综合征中很常见。在最初24小时内进行仔细的心脏监测仍然很重要。

title: Procedural Efficiency and Clinical Outcomes of a Region-Specific Radiofrequency Ablation Strategy for Pulmonary Vein Isolation.
summary:
BACKGROUND: High-power short-duration radiofrequency ablation improves procedural efficiency during pulmonary vein isolation (PVI), but concerns remain regarding lesion transmurality and posterior wall collateral injury. We evaluated whether a region-specific ablation strategy was associated with improved procedural efficiency without a detected difference in acute efficacy or 12-month arrhythmia recurrence compared with conventional ablation index-guided PVI.

METHODS: In this retrospective single-center study, 250 patients undergoing first-time PVI were treated with either ablation index-guided ablation or a region-specific strategy using very high-power short-duration applications on the posterior wall and ablation index-guided lesions on the anterior wall. The primary endpoint was first-pass isolation, analyzed per pulmonary vein using generalized estimating equations to account for within-patient clustering. Secondary endpoints included procedural efficiency, peri-procedural safety, and 12-month arrhythmia recurrence.

RESULTS: First-pass isolation was achieved in 919 of 1 000 pulmonary veins (91.9%): 454 of 500 veins (90.8%) with the region-specific strategy and 465 of 500 veins (93.0%) with ablation index-guided ablation, with no significant between-group difference (OR, 0.74; 95% CI, 0.41-1.34; p = 0.322). The region-specific strategy was associated with shorter procedure duration, ablation time, radiofrequency time, fluoroscopy time, and lower radiation dose (all p < 0.001). Acute complications occurred in 4 patients (1.6%). At 12 months, arrhythmia recurrence occurred in 43 patients (17.2%), with no detected difference between strategies.

CONCLUSIONS: A region-specific ablation strategy improved procedural efficiency without a detected difference in first-pass isolation or 12-month arrhythmia recurrence compared with ablation index-guided PVI.

AI.tldr: 区域特异性消融策略（后壁超高功率短时程+前壁消融指数引导）在首次肺静脉隔离中与消融指数引导策略相比，首次隔离率无显著差异，但手术效率显著提高，12个月心律失常复发无差异。
AI.motivation: 高功率短时程射频消融可提高肺静脉隔离（PVI）效率，但存在透壁性和后壁 collateral 损伤的担忧。本研究评估区域特异性消融策略是否能在不降低急性疗效或增加12个月复发的前提下改善手术效率。
AI.method: 回顾性单中心研究，纳入250例首次PVI患者，分为消融指数引导组和区域特异性策略组（后壁采用超高功率短时程消融，前壁采用消融指数引导消融）。主要终点为首次隔离率，以肺静脉为单位采用广义估计方程分析以考虑患者内聚集性。次要终点包括手术效率、围术期安全性和12个月心律失常复发。
AI.result: 首次隔离率总体91.9%（919/1000肺静脉），区域特异性组90.8%（454/500） vs 消融指数组93.0%（465/500），无显著差异（OR 0.74，95%CI 0.41-1.34，p=0.322）。区域特异性策略与更短的手术时间、消融时间、射频时间、透视时间和更低辐射剂量相关（均p<0.001）。急性并发症4例（1.6%）。12个月心律失常复发43例（17.2%），两组间无差异。
AI.conclusion: 区域特异性消融策略在首次隔离率和12个月心律失常复发方面与消融指数引导PVI无差异，但显著提高了手术效率。该策略可能优化PVI流程，但需注意回顾性单中心设计的局限性，未来需前瞻性研究验证。

summary_zh:
背景：高功率短时程射频消融可提高肺静脉隔离（PVI）的手术效率，但关于损伤透壁性和后壁副损伤的担忧仍然存在。我们评估了与常规消融指数指导的PVI相比，区域特异性消融策略是否与提高手术效率相关，而未检测到急性疗效或12个月心律失常复发方面的差异。

方法：在这项回顾性单中心研究中，250例首次接受PVI的患者接受了消融指数指导的消融或区域特异性策略，后者在后壁采用极高功率短时程消融，在前壁采用消融指数指导的损伤。主要终点是首次隔离，按肺静脉使用广义估计方程分析以考虑患者内聚类。次要终点包括手术效率、围手术期安全性和12个月心律失常复发。

结果：1 000条肺静脉中有919条（91.9%）实现首次隔离：区域特异性策略组500条静脉中454条（90.8%），消融指数指导消融组500条静脉中465条（93.0%），组间无显著差异（OR，0.74；95% CI，0.41-1.34；p = 0.322）。区域特异性策略与较短的手术时间、消融时间、射频时间、透视时间和较低的辐射剂量相关（所有p < 0.001）。4例患者（1.6%）发生急性并发症。12个月时，43例患者（17.2%）发生心律失常复发，两种策略之间未检测到差异。

结论：与消融指数指导的PVI相比，区域特异性消融策略提高了手术效率，而未检测到首次隔离或12个月心律失常复发方面的差异。

title: Characteristics of patients with obesity presenting with cardiac arrest and the potential role of cardioverter-defibrillator therapy: an analysis using the National Inpatient Sample database
summary: Background Obesity is a well established risk factor for cardiovascular disease and has been associated with an increased incidence of cardiac arrest. This study utilizes the National Inpatient Sample (NIS) database to analyze the characteristics of obese patients presenting with cardiac arrest and explores the potential role of implantable cardioverter-defibrillator (ICD) therapy in this population.Methods We analyzed data from the NIS database between 2016 and 2020, including obese (body mass index ≥30) adult patients with and without cardiac arrest. Baseline characteristics and comorbidities were identified using relevant ICD-10 codes. Differences in outcomes and comorbidities between the two groups, as well as factors associated with ICD placement, were evaluated using multivariable logistic regression.Results We analyzed 4 445 524 obese patients, including 88 770 individuals who presented with cardiac arrest (mean age: 63.2 ± 12.6 years) and 4 356 754 without cardiac arrest (mean age: 59.0 ± 15.2 years). Obese patients with cardiac arrest were more likely to be White men with a greater burden of comorbidities, such as hypertension, chronic ischemic heart disease, smoking, alcohol use, hyperthyroidism, congestive heart failure, and atrial and ventricular arrhythmias, with atrial fibrillation being a particularly dominant association with cardiac arrest (odds ratio: 7.80, P < 0.001). In addition, individuals with private insurance and those treated at large, urban teaching hospitals were more likely to be diagnosed with cardiac arrest, with longer hospital stays, higher costs, and increased mortality. In the setting of cardiac arrest associated with ventricular tachycardia and fibrillation, males with private insurance, higher median household incomes (> $35 000), and treatment at large, urban teaching hospitals had higher odds of ICD placement. Furthermore, obese individuals with advancing age and comorbidities - including diabetes, obstructive lung disease, peripheral vascular disease, and renal and liver disease - faced higher odds of mortality without an ICD. Compared with White patients, Asian, Pacific Islander, and Native American individuals without an ICD also had higher odds of mortality.Conclusion Obese individuals, particularly White males with comorbidities, were more likely to experience cardiac arrest, with atrial fibrillation being a strong independent risk factor even after adjustment for heart failure. Disparities in healthcare access were evident, with individuals of higher socioeconomic status more likely to receive ICDs, while certain racial groups had worse outcomes.

AI.tldr: 在肥胖住院患者中，心脏骤停者多为白人男性且合并症负担重，房颤与心脏骤停强相关（OR 7.80），社会经济地位高者更易接受ICD。
AI.motivation: 肥胖是心血管疾病和心脏骤停的明确危险因素，但肥胖合并心脏骤停患者的临床特征及ICD在该人群中的使用情况尚缺乏大样本数据。
AI.method: 基于美国国家住院患者样本（NIS）数据库2016—2020年数据，纳入肥胖（BMI≥30）成人患者，按是否发生心脏骤停分组，采用ICD-10编码识别基线特征和合并症，使用多变量logistic回归分析组间差异及与ICD植入相关的因素。
AI.result: 共分析4,445,524例肥胖患者，其中心脏骤停88,770例（平均年龄63.2±12.6岁），无心脏骤停4,356,754例（平均年龄59.0±15.2岁）。心脏骤停组以白人男性为主，高血压、慢性缺血性心脏病、吸烟、饮酒、甲亢、充血性心衰及房性和室性心律失常负担更重，房颤与心脏骤停关联最强（OR 7.80，P<0.001）。有私人保险及在大城市教学医院治疗者更易诊断心脏骤停，住院时间更长、费用更高、死亡率更高。在室速/室颤相关心脏骤停中，男性、有私人保险、家庭收入中位数>$35,000及在大城市教学医院治疗者ICD植入几率更高。高龄及合并糖尿病、阻塞性肺病、外周血管病、肾肝疾病的肥胖患者未植入ICD时死亡几率更高；与白人相比，亚裔、太平洋岛民和美洲原住民未植入ICD者死亡几率也更高。
AI.conclusion: 肥胖合并症多的白人男性更易发生心脏骤停，房颤是独立强危险因素；医疗可及性差异明显，高社会经济地位者更易接受ICD，部分种族结局更差。需关注该人群的ICD公平可及性，但本研究为回顾性数据库分析，存在编码依赖和混杂局限。

summary_zh:
背景：肥胖是心血管疾病公认的危险因素，并与心脏骤停发生率增加相关。本研究利用全国住院患者样本（NIS）数据库分析发生心脏骤停的肥胖患者的特征，并探讨植入式心律转复除颤器（ICD）治疗在该人群中的潜在作用。

方法：我们分析了2016年至2020年NIS数据库的数据，纳入伴有和不伴有心脏骤停的肥胖（体重指数≥30）成年患者。使用相关ICD-10编码确定基线特征和合并症。采用多变量logistic回归评估两组间结局和合并症的差异，以及与ICD植入相关的因素。

结果：我们分析了4 445 524例肥胖患者，包括88 770例发生心脏骤停的患者（平均年龄：63.2 ± 12.6岁）和4 356 754例未发生心脏骤停的患者（平均年龄：59.0 ± 15.2岁）。发生心脏骤停的肥胖患者更可能是白人男性，且合并症负担更重，如高血压、慢性缺血性心脏病、吸烟、饮酒、甲状腺功能亢进、充血性心力衰竭以及房性和室性心律失常，中心房颤动与心脏骤停的关联尤为显著（比值比：7.80，P < 0.001）。此外，拥有私人保险的个体以及在大型城市教学医院接受治疗的个体更可能被诊断为心脏骤停，且住院时间更长、费用更高、死亡率增加。在与室性心动过速和心室颤动相关的心脏骤停情况下，拥有私人保险、家庭收入中位数较高（> 35 000美元）且在大型城市教学医院接受治疗的男性接受ICD植入的几率更高。此外，高龄且伴有合并症（包括糖尿病、阻塞性肺疾病、外周血管疾病以及肾脏和肝脏疾病）的肥胖个体在未植入ICD的情况下死亡几率更高。与白人患者相比，未植入ICD的亚洲人、太平洋岛民和美洲原住民个体的死亡几率也更高。

结论：肥胖个体，尤其是伴有合并症的白人男性，更可能发生心脏骤停，中心房颤动即使在调整心力衰竭后仍是一个强的独立危险因素。医疗可及性方面的差异显而易见，社会经济地位较高的个体更可能接受ICD，而某些种族群体的结局更差。

title: Evaluation of Intraprocedural Strategies to Assess Acute Pulmonary Vein Isolation After First-Pass Wide Antral Circumferential Ablation
summary: Background: Atrial fibrillation (AF) is the most common sustained cardiac arrhythmia. While pulmonary vein isolation (PVI) remains the cornerstone of AF ablation, the optimal method for confirming complete acute isolation remains uncertain. This study evaluated the diagnostic value of pulmonary vein (PV) pacing compared with repeat three-dimensional (3D) electroanatomical mapping following wide antral circumferential ablation (WACA). Methods: In this prospective observational study, 58 patients with paroxysmal or persistent AF undergoing bilateral WACA at the University Heart Center Ulm between November 2023 and April 2025 were included. Following successful PVI, pacing was performed from each PV and the corresponding carina region using a maximal stimulation output of 20 mA. Subsequently, comprehensive 3D re-mapping was performed to reassess electrical conduction. Results obtained from pacing maneuvers were compared with repeat mapping findings. Results: The study population had a median age of 73 (62.7-78.2) years and a median body mass index of 26.8 (24.0-29.9) kg/m2. Median left atrial diameter was 4.8 (4.3-5.5) cm, and moderate to advanced atrial fibrosis was present in approximately one-third of patients. For the left-sided PVs, pacing assessment alone was associated with a significantly higher proportion of false-negative results compared with 3D re-mapping (left upper PV: p = 0.039; left inferior PV: p = 0.012). In contrast, no significant differences were observed for the right PVs. Evaluation of the carina regions showed a similar pattern, with a significant discrepancy on the left side (p = 0.002) but not on the right side (p = 0.453). Conclusions: PV pacing alone may not reliably identify residual conduction within the left PVs and left carina after WACA. Additional 3D re-mapping appears valuable in these regions to detect persistent conduction gaps that could otherwise remain unnoticed. For right-sided PVs, pacing-based assessment may provide sufficient confirmation of acute isolation in many cases. These findings support a complementary use of both techniques to improve procedural verification of PVI. Larger prospective studies are warranted to confirm the observed results and determine their clinical implications.

AI.tldr: 在WACA后，仅用肺静脉起搏评估左侧肺静脉及左carina的急性隔离假阴性率显著高于三维电解剖标测，右侧则无显著差异，提示左侧需补充标测。
AI.motivation: 肺静脉隔离（PVI）是房颤消融的基石，但确认急性完全隔离的最佳方法尚不明确，本研究旨在比较肺静脉起搏与重复三维电解剖标测在宽环状消融（WACA）后的诊断价值。
AI.method: 前瞻性观察性研究，纳入2023年11月至2025年4月在Ulm大学心脏中心接受双侧WACA的58例阵发性或持续性房颤患者。成功PVI后，以最大20 mA输出从每根肺静脉及相应carina区域起搏，随后进行全面的三维电解剖再标测评估电传导，比较起搏与再标测结果。
AI.result: 中位年龄73岁，中位BMI 26.8 kg/m²，中位左房内径4.8 cm，约三分之一患者存在中重度心房纤维化。左侧肺静脉：起搏评估假阴性比例显著高于三维再标测（左上肺静脉P=0.039；左下肺静脉P=0.012）；右侧肺静脉无显著差异。carina区域：左侧差异显著（P=0.002），右侧无显著差异（P=0.453）。
AI.conclusion: WACA后仅用肺静脉起搏可能无法可靠识别左侧肺静脉及左carina的残余传导，补充三维再标测有助于发现可能被遗漏的传导间隙；右侧肺静脉起搏评估在多情况下可提供足够的急性隔离确认。研究支持两种技术互补使用以提高PVI验证的可靠性，但样本量有限，需更大规模前瞻性研究证实。

summary_zh:
背景：心房颤动（AF）是最常见的持续性心律失常。尽管肺静脉隔离（PVI）仍是AF消融的基石，但确认急性完全隔离的最佳方法仍不确定。本研究评估了在宽前庭环状消融（WACA）后，肺静脉（PV）起搏与重复三维（3D）电解剖标测相比的诊断价值。

方法：在这项前瞻性观察性研究中，纳入了2023年11月至2025年4月期间在乌尔姆大学心脏中心接受双侧WACA的58例阵发性或持续性AF患者。在成功PVI后，使用最大刺激输出20 mA从每个PV及相应隆突区域进行起搏。随后，进行全面的3D重新标测以重新评估电传导。将起搏操作获得的结果与重复标测发现进行比较。

结果：研究人群的中位年龄为73（62.7-78.2）岁，中位体重指数为26.8（24.0-29.9）kg/m2。中位左心房直径为4.8（4.3-5.5）cm，约三分之一患者存在中度至晚期心房纤维化。对于左侧PV，与3D重新标测相比，仅起搏评估与显著更高的假阴性结果比例相关（左上PV：p = 0.039；左下PV：p = 0.012）。相比之下，右侧PV未观察到显著差异。隆突区域的评估显示相似模式，左侧存在显著差异（p = 0.002），而右侧无显著差异（p = 0.453）。

结论：在WACA后，仅PV起搏可能无法可靠识别左侧PV和左隆突内的残余传导。在这些区域，额外的3D重新标测似乎有价值，以检测可能否则未被注意的持续传导间隙。对于右侧PV，基于起搏的评估在许多情况下可能提供足够的急性隔离确认。这些发现支持两种技术的互补使用，以改善PVI的手术验证。需要更大规模的前瞻性研究来确认观察到的结果并确定其临床意义。

title: Transient changes in P-wave terminal force after electrical cardioversion of persistent atrial fibrillation.
summary:
BACKGROUND: P-wave terminal force in lead V1 (PWTFV1) reflects left atrial remodeling and is associated with atrial fibrillation (AF) outcomes, but its time course after electrical cardioversion of persistent AF is unclear.

METHODS: We retrospectively analyzed 108 patients with persistent AF after successful electrical cardioversion, with 12‑lead electrocardiograms at 30 min, 1 month, and 3 months. Terminal P-wave duration (PNTV1) and amplitude (PNAV1) in lead V1 were measured and PWTFV1 calculated as their product; changes are expressed in absolute magnitude. Correlations with left atrial diameter and categorical classification (abnormal if magnitude ≥4000 ms·μV) were assessed.

RESULTS: PNTV1 increased at 1 month versus 30 min (60 ± 25 vs 58 ± 19 ms; P = 0.018) and returned to baseline at 3 months (57 ± 19 ms; P = 0.83; Friedman P = 0.031). PNAV1 was unchanged (P = 0.37). PWTFV1 increased transiently in magnitude at 1 month (-4294 ± 2545 vs -4079 ± 2138 ms·μV; P = 0.022) and normalized at 3 months (-4039 ± 2060 ms·μV; P = 0.64). PWTFV1 did not correlate with left atrial diameter (all |ρ| ≈ 0.05, P ≥ 0.61), and categorical classification was unchanged (57/108 abnormal throughout; no patient reclassified).

CONCLUSION: PWTFV1 shows transient, duration-driven variability after cardioversion, peaking at 1 month. The change is small, does not alter categorical classification, and is not mirrored by left atrial size, consistent with ongoing atrial recovery rather than stable remodeling. Timing of assessment matters when PWTFV1 is interpreted as a continuous measure.

AI.tldr: 持续性房颤电复律后，P波终末力（PWTFV1）在1个月时出现短暂性增大，3个月恢复基线，但变化幅度小且不改变分类，与左房大小无关。
AI.motivation: PWTFV1反映左房重构并与房颤结局相关，但持续性房颤电复律后其时间变化过程尚不明确，临床解读PWTFV1时缺乏时序参考。
AI.method: 回顾性分析108例持续性房颤成功电复律患者，于复律后30分钟、1个月和3个月记录12导联心电图，测量V1导联终末P波时限（PNTV1）和振幅（PNAV1），计算PWTFV1（两者乘积），以绝对值表示变化。评估PWTFV1与左房直径的相关性，并按异常标准（绝对值≥4000 ms·μV）进行二分类。统计方法包括Friedman检验和相关性分析。
AI.result: PNTV1在1个月时较30分钟增加（60±25 vs 58±19 ms；P=0.018），3个月恢复基线（57±19 ms；P=0.83；Friedman P=0.031）。PNAV1无变化（P=0.37）。PWTFV1绝对值在1个月时短暂增大（-4294±2545 vs -4079±2138 ms·μV；P=0.022），3个月恢复（-4039±2060 ms·μV；P=0.64）。PWTFV1与左房直径无相关性（所有|ρ|≈0.05，P≥0.61），分类无变化（57/108例始终异常，无患者重新分类）。
AI.conclusion: 电复律后PWTFV1呈现短暂、由时限驱动的变异，1个月达峰，但变化幅度小，不改变分类，且与左房大小无关，提示心房仍在恢复而非稳定重构。临床以PWTFV1连续值解读时需注意评估时机。

summary_zh:
背景：V1导联P波终末电势（PWTFV1）反映左心房重构，并与心房颤动（AF）的结局相关，但其在持续性AF电复律后的时间进程尚不清楚。

方法：我们回顾性分析了108例持续性AF成功电复律后的患者，在30分钟、1个月和3个月时进行12导联心电图检查。测量V1导联终末P波时限（PNTV1）和振幅（PNAV1），并计算其乘积作为PWTFV1；变化以绝对值大小表示。评估其与左心房直径的相关性及分类（若绝对值≥4000 ms·μV则为异常）。

结果：PNTV1在1个月时较30分钟时增加（60 ± 25 vs 58 ± 19 ms；P = 0.018），并在3个月时恢复至基线（57 ± 19 ms；P = 0.83；Friedman P = 0.031）。PNAV1无变化（P = 0.37）。PWTFV1的绝对值在1个月时出现一过性增加（-4294 ± 2545 vs -4079 ± 2138 ms·μV；P = 0.022），并在3个月时恢复正常（-4039 ± 2060 ms·μV；P = 0.64）。PWTFV1与左心房直径无相关性（所有|ρ| ≈ 0.05，P ≥ 0.61），且分类无变化（全程57/108例异常；无患者被重新分类）。

结论：PWTFV1在复律后显示一过性、由时限驱动的变异性，在1个月时达峰。该变化幅度小，不改变分类，且未反映在左心房大小上，这与持续的心房恢复而非稳定重构相一致。当PWTFV1作为连续指标解读时，评估时机很重要。

title: Three sham-controlled trials of catheter ablation for atrial fibrillation do not estimate the same quantity: a systematic review and estimand-harmonised re-analysis
summary: This project is a systematic review and estimand-harmonised re-analysis of randomised sham-controlled trials of catheter ablation for symptomatic atrial fibrillation. Three sham-controlled randomised trials have reported quality-of-life outcomes after catheter ablation, but their headline treatment effects are based on different statistical estimands. These include an unadjusted mean difference in change from baseline, a baseline-adjusted mean difference at follow-up, and a median location shift. Pooling these estimates directly may therefore combine quantities that are not statistically equivalent and may attribute part of the resulting heterogeneity to differences in treatment effect when it instead reflects differences in estimand definition. The primary objective of this review is to quantify how much of the between-trial heterogeneity in reported AFEQT quality-of-life effects is attributable to estimand definition. Eligible trials will be re-analysed using explicitly defined common estimands, and between-trial variance will be compared across those estimands. The primary comparison will evaluate heterogeneity under: 1. the unadjusted mean difference in AFEQT change from baseline to 6 months; and 2. the baseline-adjusted mean difference in AFEQT at 6 months. Median location-shift estimates will be recorded and described separately where available and will not be pooled with mean-difference estimands. Secondary objectives include reporting the pooled treatment effect separately for each estimand, identifying trial-level mechanisms that contribute to estimand-dependent changes in treatment estimates, examining the effect of baseline-anchor selection on sham-arm response, and describing trial-level characteristics associated with residual discordance. Eligible studies are randomised controlled trials enrolling adults with symptomatic paroxysmal or persistent atrial fibrillation, comparing catheter ablation including pulmonary vein isolation with a sham or placebo procedure. The control procedure must not include a protocol-mandated active rhythm-control intervention for all control participants. The primary outcome is the AFEQT global score at approximately 6 months. Secondary outcomes include AFEQT subdomains, arrhythmia recurrence, antiarrhythmic drug restart, and serious procedure-related adverse events. Random-effects meta-analysis will use restricted maximum likelihood estimation with Hartung-Knapp confidence intervals. Prediction intervals will be reported where appropriate. Continuous outcomes will be analysed as mean differences. Binary outcomes will be analysed primarily as risk ratios, with rare and zero-event outcomes assessed using Mantel-Haenszel exact and Peto approaches without routine continuity correction. Sensitivity analyses will include alternative assumptions for change-score correlations, Hartung-Knapp versus Wald inference, leave-one-out analyses, alternative recurrence definitions, and intention-to-treat versus per-protocol analyses. Risk of bias will be assessed using RoB 2 at the outcome level, and certainty of evidence will be evaluated using GRADE. At the time of registration, literature searches, screening, and data extraction had been completed and preliminary analyses had been performed. The central estimand hypothesis was generated on 29 September 2026 during review of PFA-SHAM supplementary material and is therefore explicitly considered post hoc. This registration is intended to transparently document and fix the subsequent analysis plan; it does not claim prospective prespecification. An overlapping systematic review was registered by Saplaouras et al. on 5 September 2026. That review primarily evaluates the effect of catheter ablation versus sham on quality-of-life and arrhythmia outcomes. The present project addresses a different methodological question: whether the sham-controlled trials estimate a common treatment quantity and how much observed between-trial heterogeneity is attributable to differences in estimand definition. A separate individual participant data meta-analysis involving the same trials is planned and will be registered independently.

AI.tldr: 三项假手术对照消融试验因使用不同统计估计量（未调整均值差、基线调整均值差、中位数位置偏移），其AFEQT疗效异质性可能部分源于估计量定义差异而非真实疗效不同。
AI.motivation: 已发表的三项假手术对照导管消融随机试验报告了生活质量结局，但主要疗效估计基于不同统计估计量，直接合并可能混合非等价统计量，并将异质性错误归因于治疗效应差异。本研究旨在量化AFEQT疗效的试验间异质性中可归因于估计量定义的比例。
AI.method: 系统综述与估计量协调再分析。纳入标准：成人症状性阵发性或持续性AF、比较导管消融（含PVI）与假手术/安慰剂操作的RCT，对照不得强制所有患者接受积极节律控制。主要终点为约6个月时AFEQT全局评分。主要比较两种估计量下的异质性：1. 基线至6个月AFEQT变化的未调整均值差；2. 6个月时AFEQT的基线调整均值差。中位数位置偏移单独描述不合并。采用随机效应meta分析（限制最大似然估计、Hartung-Knapp置信区间），报告预测区间；二分类结局以风险比为主，罕见/零事件用Mantel-Haenszel精确法和Peto法。敏感性分析包括变化评分相关性假设、Hartung-Knapp vs Wald推断、留一法、复发定义、ITT vs PP。用RoB 2评估偏倚风险，GRADE评估证据确定性。核心估计量假设为事后提出。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体试验数量、样本量、效应量、95%CI或P值等结果数据。
AI.conclusion: 本研究将明确假手术对照消融试验是否估计同一治疗量，并量化估计量定义对异质性的贡献，为未来试验设计和证据合成提供方法学依据。局限性包括核心假设为事后提出、证据确定性需GRADE评估，且结果尚未报告。

summary_zh: 本项目是对症状性心房颤动导管消融的随机假手术对照试验的系统评价和估计目标协调再分析。三项假手术对照随机试验报告了导管消融后的生活质量结局，但其主要治疗效应基于不同的统计估计目标。这些包括未调整的基线变化均值差、随访时基线调整的均值差以及中位数位置偏移。因此，直接合并这些估计值可能组合了统计上不等价的量，并可能将由此产生的异质性部分归因于治疗效应的差异，而实际上它反映的是估计目标定义的差异。本综述的主要目的是量化报告的AFEQT生活质量效应中试验间异质性有多少可归因于估计目标定义。符合条件的试验将使用明确定义的共同估计目标进行再分析，并在这些估计目标之间比较试验间方差。主要比较将评估以下情况下的异质性：1. AFEQT从基线至6个月变化的未调整均值差；和2. 6个月时AFEQT的基线调整均值差。中位数位置偏移估计值将在可用时单独记录和描述，并且不与均值差估计目标合并。次要目标包括分别报告每个估计目标的合并治疗效应，识别导致治疗估计值随估计目标变化的试验水平机制，检查基线锚点选择对假手术组反应的影响，以及描述与残余不一致相关的试验水平特征。符合条件的研究是随机对照试验，纳入患有症状性阵发性或持续性心房颤动的成人，比较包括肺静脉隔离在内的导管消融与假手术或安慰剂操作。对照操作不得包括对所有对照参与者强制实施的积极节律控制干预。主要结局是大约6个月时的AFEQT全局评分。次要结局包括AFEQT子域、心律失常复发、抗心律失常药物重启以及严重的操作相关不良事件。随机效应荟萃分析将使用限制性最大似然估计与Hartung-Knapp置信区间。预测区间将在适当情况下报告。连续结局将分析为均值差。二分类结局将主要分析为风险比，罕见和零事件结局使用Mantel-Haenszel精确法和Peto方法评估，不进行常规连续性校正。敏感性分析将包括变化评分相关性的替代假设、Hartung-Knapp与Wald推断、留一法分析、替代复发定义以及意向性治疗与符合方案分析。偏倚风险将在结局水平使用RoB 2评估，证据确定性将使用GRADE评估。在注册时，文献检索、筛选和数据提取已完成，初步分析已进行。核心估计目标假设于2026年9月29日在审查PFA-SHAM补充材料期间产生，因此明确视为事后。本注册旨在透明地记录和固定后续分析计划；它不声称前瞻性预先指定。Saplaouras等人于2026年9月5日注册了一项重叠的系统评价。该评价主要评估导管消融与假手术对生活质量和心律失常结局的影响。本项目解决不同的方法学问题：假手术对照试验是否估计共同的治疗量，以及观察到的试验间异质性有多少可归因于估计目标定义的差异。计划进行一项涉及相同试验的单独个体参与者数据荟萃分析，并将独立注册。

title: Sleep Health in Patients With Permanent Pacemakers: A Scoping Review of Patient-Reported Outcomes, Pacing Strategies, and Continuous Device Monitoring
summary: This scoping review aims to systematically map the existing evidence on sleep health in adults with permanent pacemakers. The review will examine four interconnected areas: patient-reported sleep and recovery outcomes, pacing strategies and their effects on sleep physiology, the burden and measurement of sleep-disordered breathing, and continuous device-derived respiratory monitoring and its clinical associations. The review will characterize the distribution, methodological features, and temporal evolution of the evidence, summarize consistent and inconsistent findings across these research domains, and identify gaps relevant to patient-centred care and the clinical interpretation of device-derived sleep-related data. Particular attention will be given to the relationship between device-detected respiratory disturbance, atrial fibrillation, and the potential role of implanted devices in longitudinal sleep monitoring. The expected outcomes are a structured evidence map of current research, clarification of areas in which findings are sufficiently consistent to inform future investigation, and identification of priorities for further studies, including integration of patient-reported and objective sleep measures, external validation of device-derived respiratory indices, and prospective evaluation of clinically actionable pathways linking abnormal device signals to confirmatory assessment, targeted management, and patient outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本范围综述计划系统梳理永久起搏器成人患者睡眠健康证据，涵盖患者报告结局、起搏策略、睡眠呼吸障碍负担及设备呼吸监测，并关注设备检测呼吸紊乱与房颤的关联。
AI.motivation: 永久起搏器患者睡眠健康证据分散，患者报告结局、起搏策略对睡眠生理影响、睡眠呼吸障碍测量负担及设备衍生呼吸监测的临床关联尚不明确，缺乏结构化证据图谱以指导患者中心照护和设备数据解读。
AI.method: 研究类型为范围综述，研究对象为植入永久起搏器的成人患者，样本量摘要未报告。将系统映射四个领域：患者报告睡眠与恢复结局、起搏策略对睡眠生理的影响、睡眠呼吸障碍负担与测量、连续设备衍生呼吸监测及其临床关联。主要终点为证据分布、方法学特征和时间演变，总结一致与不一致发现并识别证据缺口；统计方法为描述性证据映射，摘要未报告具体统计方法。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体研究结果、效应量、95%置信区间或P值。预期产出为结构化证据图谱，明确哪些领域发现足够一致可指导未来研究，并识别研究优先方向，包括整合患者报告与客观睡眠测量、设备衍生呼吸指标的外部验证、以及将异常设备信号链接至确诊评估、针对性管理和患者结局的前瞻性评估。
AI.conclusion: 本范围综述将为起搏器患者睡眠健康提供证据地图，明确设备检测呼吸紊乱与房颤的关联及植入设备在纵向睡眠监测中的潜在作用，为电生理实践中设备数据解读和患者中心照护提供方向。局限性在于为范围综述而非系统评价或荟萃分析，不提供定量合并效应，且摘要未报告具体结果。

summary_zh: 本范围综述旨在系统梳理关于成人永久起搏器患者睡眠健康的现有证据。该综述将审查四个相互关联的领域：患者报告的睡眠与恢复结局、起搏策略及其对睡眠生理的影响、睡眠呼吸障碍的负担与测量，以及连续设备衍生的呼吸监测及其临床关联。该综述将描述证据的分布、方法学特征和时间演变，总结这些研究领域中一致和不一致的发现，并识别与以患者为中心的护理及设备衍生睡眠相关数据的临床解读相关的空白。将特别关注设备检测到的呼吸紊乱、心房颤动之间的关系，以及植入设备在纵向睡眠监测中的潜在作用。预期成果是当前研究的结构化证据图，明确发现足够一致以指导未来研究的领域，并确定进一步研究的优先事项，包括整合患者报告和客观睡眠测量、设备衍生呼吸指数的外部验证，以及前瞻性评估将异常设备信号与确诊性评估、针对性管理和患者结局联系起来的临床可操作路径。

title: Outcomes of a Simplified Two-Catheter Approach for Catheter Ablation of SVT in Pediatric Patients.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Catheter ablations are an established treatment for supraventricular tachycardia (SVT) in pediatric patients with high success and low complication rates typically. This study evaluated the procedural outcomes, safety, and recurrence rates of pediatric patients undergoing SVT ablation using a two-catheter approach.

METHODS: A retrospective review was performed of 150 pediatric patients who underwent electrophysiology studies and catheter ablation for SVT. All patients were younger than 21 years, with arrhythmia mechanisms including atrioventricular nodal reentrant tachycardia (AVNRT), ectopic atrial tachycardia (EAT), atrial flutter, and other accessory pathway-mediated tachycardias. All electrophysiology (EP) studies and catheter ablations were performed using a two-catheter access approach at the University of California at Davis by a sole operator with typically just a catheter in the coronary sinus and a second linear catheter (right atrial/ ventricular/ His) to start. All patients had follow-up of one year or if recurrence than 1 year from subsequent ablation.

RESULTS: Acute procedural success was achieved in all patients. The median age at the time of ablation was 13 years (IQR: 8-16 years). The median weight and height were 53.9 kg (IQR: 34.6-67.6 kg) and 157.3 cm (IQR: 137-170 cm), respectively. No intraprocedural complications were observed, including vascular access complications. Additionally, no postprocedural complications occurred, including pericardial effusion, cardiac tamponade, air embolism, thrombus formation, or heart block. Two patients experienced arrhythmia recurrence within 12 months of follow-up, corresponding to a recurrence rate of 1.3% and an overall success rate of 98.7%. Recurrence occurred in one patient with a Mahaim pathway and one patient with a left posterolateral accessory pathway.

CONCLUSION: A two-catheter access approach may be safely performed with good short-and medium-term outcomes in pediatric patients.

AI.tldr: 儿童SVT消融采用简化双导管法，150例急性成功100%，无并发症，1年复发率1.3%，总成功率98.7%。
AI.motivation: 儿童室上性心动过速（SVT）导管消融通常成功率高、并发症低，但标准多导管策略可能增加血管通路风险。本研究旨在评估简化双导管法在儿童SVT消融中的手术结局、安全性和复发率，以填补该简化策略在儿童人群中的证据缺口。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性研究，纳入150例年龄<21岁、因SVT接受电生理检查及导管消融的儿童患者，心律失常机制包括房室结折返性心动过速（AVNRT）、异位房性心动过速（EAT）、心房扑动及其他旁路介导的心动过速。所有手术均由加州大学戴维斯分校同一术者采用双导管入路完成，通常仅置入冠状窦导管及一根右房/右室/希氏束线性导管。随访至少1年，若复发则随访至再次消融后1年。主要终点为急性手术成功、围术期及术后并发症和12个月内复发率。
AI.result: 所有患者均实现急性手术成功。消融时中位年龄13岁（IQR 8-16岁），中位体重53.9 kg（IQR 34.6-67.6 kg），中位身高157.3 cm（IQR 137-170 cm）。无术中并发症（包括血管通路并发症），也无术后并发症（包括心包积液、心脏压塞、空气栓塞、血栓形成或心脏传导阻滞）。随访12个月内2例复发，复发率1.3%，总成功率98.7%；复发者分别为1例Mahaim旁路和1例左后侧旁路患者。
AI.conclusion: 在儿童SVT患者中，双导管入路消融可安全实施，并具有良好的短期和中期结局（总成功率98.7%，无并发症）。该简化策略可能减少导管数量和血管通路风险，但本研究为单术者、单中心回顾性设计，样本量有限，结论需前瞻性多中心研究进一步验证。

summary_zh:
背景：导管消融是儿童室上性心动过速（SVT）的既定治疗方法，通常成功率高且并发症率低。本研究评估了采用两导管法行SVT消融的儿科患者的手术结局、安全性和复发率。

方法：对150例因SVT接受电生理检查和导管消融的儿科患者进行了回顾性 review。所有患者均小于21岁，心律失常机制包括房室结折返性心动过速（AVNRT）、异位房性心动过速（EAT）、心房扑动和其他旁路介导的心动过速。所有电生理（EP）检查和导管消融均在加州大学戴维斯分校由单一术者采用两导管入路方法进行，通常仅从冠状窦导管和第二根线性导管（右心房/心室/希氏束）开始。所有患者均随访一年，若复发则从后续消融起随访超过1年。

结果：所有患者均获得急性手术成功。消融时的中位年龄为13岁（IQR：8-16岁）。中位体重和身高分别为53.9 kg（IQR：34.6-67.6 kg）和157.3 cm（IQR：137-170 cm）。未观察到术中并发症，包括血管入路并发症。此外，未发生术后并发症，包括心包积液、心脏压塞、空气栓塞、血栓形成或心脏传导阻滞。两名患者在12个月随访内出现心律失常复发，对应复发率为1.3%，总成功率为98.7%。复发发生在一名Mahaim旁路患者和一名左后侧旁路患者中。

结论：两导管入路方法可安全实施，在儿科患者中具有良好的短期和中期结局。

title: Building a surgical atrial fibrillation program: Programmatic evolution, safety, and three-year rhythm outcomes of hybrid ablation.
summary:
OBJECTIVE: Surgical ablation is a guideline-supported treatment for symptomatic persistent and long standing persistent atrial fibrillation (AF) refractory to catheter ablation, but how a program is built, refined, and sustained has not been described. We sought to describe the development of a de novo surgical ablation program as well as its procedural evolution, safety profile, and long-term rhythm outcomes.

METHODS: We reviewed the programmatic evolution of our program and growth of procedural volume and complexity. We also analyzed the long-term electrophysiologic and safety outcomes of all patients undergoing minimally invasive surgical ablation from 2020 to 2024. Rhythm assessment was performed using 12 lead ECG, wearable monitor, implantable loop recorder, or ICD/PPM interrogation following a 3-month blanking period after endocardial ablation.

RESULTS: One hundred and twenty-five consecutive patients undergoing hybrid surgical ablation between 2020 and 2024 at our institution were analyzed. Of which, one hundred and twelve had sufficient follow-up data. At 1, 2, and 3 years of follow-up, 94%, 85%, and 70% of patients were in normal sinus rhythm with 67% of those patients remaining off class I/III antiarrhythmic therapy at three years. There were no peri-procedural deaths, conversions to sternotomy, tamponade, strokes, or atrio-esophageal fistulae. Thirty-day adverse events occurred in 4 patients (3.6%) and included three patients with pericarditis and one patient with transient phrenic nerve palsy. The volume at our institution increased fourfold during the study period paralleled by increasing complexity and scope of operations.

CONCLUSIONS: This experience provides a roadmap for developing a multifaceted hybrid ablation program with excellent safety and durable rhythm outcomes.

AI.tldr: 单中心125例杂交消融治疗持续性房颤，1、2、3年窦性心律维持率分别为94%、85%、70%，无围术期死亡或严重并发症。
AI.motivation: 外科消融是导管消融难治性症状性持续性和长程持续性房颤的指南支持治疗，但如何建立、优化和维持外科消融项目尚无描述，且缺乏长期节律结局数据。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性研究，分析2020-2024年连续125例接受微创杂交外科消融的患者，其中112例有足够随访数据。评估项目发展、手术量和复杂性变化，以及长期电生理和安全结局。节律评估采用12导联心电图、可穿戴监测器、植入式循环记录器或ICD/PPM interrogation，在内膜消融后3个月空白期后进行。
AI.result: 随访1、2、3年时，正常窦性心律维持率分别为94%、85%、70%，其中67%的患者在3年时未使用I/III类抗心律失常药物。无围术期死亡、中转开胸、心包填塞、卒中或房食管瘘。30天不良事件4例（3.6%），包括3例心包炎和1例短暂性膈神经麻痹。研究期间手术量增加4倍，手术复杂性和范围同步增加。
AI.conclusion: 该经验为建立多学科杂交消融项目提供了路线图，具有优异的安全性和持久的节律结局。但为单中心回顾性研究，样本量有限，需更大规模研究验证。

summary_zh:
目的：外科消融是指南支持的治疗方法，适用于有症状的持续性及长程持续性心房颤动（AF）且导管消融难治的患者，但如何建立、完善并维持一个项目尚未见描述。我们旨在描述一个从零开始的外科消融项目的发展历程及其手术演进、安全性特征和长期节律结局。

方法：我们回顾了本项目的项目化演进以及手术量和复杂性的增长。我们还分析了2020年至2024年所有接受微创外科消融患者的长期电生理和安全性结局。节律评估采用12导联心电图、可穿戴监测器、植入式循环记录仪，或心内膜消融后3个月空白期后ICD/PPM程控检查。

结果：分析了2020年至2024年间在本机构接受杂交外科消融的125例连续患者。其中112例有足够的随访数据。在随访1年、2年和3年时，分别有94%、85%和70%的患者处于正常窦性心律，其中67%的患者在三年时仍未使用I/III类抗心律失常药物治疗。无围手术期死亡、中转胸骨切开、心脏压塞、卒中或心房食管瘘。30天不良事件发生于4例患者（3.6%），包括3例心包炎和1例暂时性膈神经麻痹。在研究期间，本机构的手术量增加了四倍，同时手术的复杂性和范围也在增加。

结论：这一经验为建立一个具有优异安全性和持久节律结局的多方面杂交消融项目提供了路线图。

title: Assessment of Patients’ Awareness of Anticoagulant Use in Atrial Fibrillation: A Cross-Sectional Survey
summary: OBJECTIVE: Atrial fibrillation (AF) increases thromboembolic risk, and oral anticoagulants (OACs) substantially reduce this risk; however, their safe and effective use requires adequate patient knowledge. We aimed to assess AF- and OAC-related awareness among Turkish patients and to identify predictors of knowledge. METHOD: This single-center, cross-sectional survey was conducted between July 1, 2024 and January 1, 2025, and included consecutive adults with non-valvular AF receiving warfarin or direct OACs for at least three months. A structured questionnaire collected data on demographic characteristics, comorbidities, medication use, adherence, and knowledge across six domains: arrhythmia name, treatment indication, dosing schedule, side effects, drug and food interactions, and consequences of dose modification. A composite knowledge score (range, 0���6) was calculated. Multivariable linear regression was used to evaluate predictors of knowledge, including age, sex, and education level. Ethics approval was obtained, and all participants provided written informed consent. RESULTS: A total of 261 patients were included (median age, 67 years; 50.2% women). Hypertension and diabetes mellitus were present in 64.8% and 32.2% of patients, respectively. Direct oral anticoagulants (DOACs) accounted for 72.4% of prescriptions, whereas 27.6% of patients received warfarin. Although 36% of participants had AF for more than six years, only 16.5% could correctly name their arrhythmia. While 92% knew they were taking an anticoagulant, 24% misunderstood its indication. Knowledge of side effects was limited, with 68% reporting no awareness. Awareness of interactions was poor: 88% reported no knowledge of drug���drug interactions, and 71% were unaware of food interactions. Most patients knew their dosing schedule (92.3%) and reported that they would not double a missed dose (99.6%). Self-reported adherence was high (94% 'always' and 4% 'often'), and taking medication with meals was associated with better adherence (���� = 17.0, P < 0.001). The mean knowledge score was 2.8 +- 1.3 (Cronbach's �� = 0.50). Higher educational attainment and female sex were associated with greater knowledge, whereas age was inversely associated with knowledge. CONCLUSION: Despite high self-reported adherence, substantial knowledge gaps persist among patients receiving anticoagulation for AF, particularly regarding side effects and drug or food interactions. Targeted, health-literacy-sensitive educational strategies may improve medication safety and clinical outcomes in patients receiving anticoagulation for AF.
journal: Turk Kardiyoloji Dernegi Arsivi-Archives of the Turkish Society of Cardiology

AI.tldr: 土耳其非瓣膜性房颤抗凝患者虽自报依从性高，但对抗凝药副作用及药物/食物相互作用的认知存在显著缺口，知识评分仅2.8/6。
AI.motivation: 房颤增加血栓栓塞风险，口服抗凝药可显著降低该风险，但其安全有效使用要求患者具备足够知识。既往证据显示患者对抗凝治疗的认知可能不足，但土耳其人群中房颤及口服抗凝药相关认知状况及其预测因素尚不明确。
AI.method: 单中心横断面调查，纳入2024年7月1日至2025年1月1日连续就诊的成人非瓣膜性房颤患者，要求使用华法林或直接口服抗凝药至少3个月，共261例。采用结构化问卷收集人口学特征、合并症、用药、依从性及六个领域的知识（心律失常名称、治疗指征、给药方案、副作用、药物和食物相互作用、剂量调整后果），计算复合知识评分（0-6分）。采用多变量线性回归评估年龄、性别和教育水平等知识预测因素。
AI.result: 中位年龄67岁，女性50.2%；高血压64.8%，糖尿病32.2%；DOAC处方占72.4%，华法林27.6%。36%患者房颤病程超过6年，但仅16.5%能正确说出心律失常名称；92%知道正在服用抗凝药，但24%误解其指征；68%对副作用无认知；88%不了解药物-药物相互作用，71%不了解食物相互作用。92.3%知道给药方案，99.6%表示不会加倍漏服剂量。自报依从性高（94%“总是”，4%“经常”），随餐服药与更好依从性相关（β=17.0，P<0.001）。平均知识评分2.8±1.3（Cronbach's α=0.50）。较高教育水平和女性与更高知识相关，年龄与知识负相关。
AI.conclusion: 尽管自报依从性高，房颤抗凝患者仍存在显著知识缺口，尤其对副作用及药物或食物相互作用认知不足。针对健康素养的教育策略可能改善用药安全和临床结局。本研究为单中心横断面设计，知识评分内部一致性较低（α=0.50），结果外推需谨慎。

summary_zh: 目的：心房颤动（AF）增加血栓栓塞风险，口服抗凝药（OACs）可显著降低此风险；然而，其安全有效的使用需要患者具备充分的知识。我们旨在评估土耳其患者对AF和OAC相关知识的知晓情况，并确定知识的预测因素。方法：这项单中心、横断面调查于2024年7月1日至2025年1月1日进行，连续纳入接受华法林或直接口服抗凝药治疗至少三个月的非瓣膜性AF成人患者。采用结构化问卷收集人口学特征、合并症、用药情况、依从性以及六个领域的知识：心律失常名称、治疗指征、给药方案、副作用、药物和食物相互作用以及剂量调整的后果。计算复合知识评分（范围0-6）。使用多变量线性回归评估知识的预测因素，包括年龄、性别和教育水平。获得伦理批准，所有参与者提供书面知情同意。结果：共纳入261例患者（中位年龄67岁；50.2%为女性）。高血压和糖尿病分别占64.8%和32.2%。直接口服抗凝药（DOACs）占处方的72.4%，而27.6%的患者接受华法林。尽管36%的参与者AF病程超过六年，但仅16.5%能正确说出其心律失常名称。92%知道正在服用抗凝药，但24%误解其指征。对副作用的了解有限，68%报告不知晓。对相互作用的知晓率低：88%报告不了解药物-药物相互作用，71%不了解食物相互作用。大多数患者知道其给药方案（92.3%），并报告不会将漏服的剂量加倍（99.6%）。自我报告的依从性高（94%“总是”和4%“经常”），随餐服药与更好的依从性相关（β = 17.0，P < 0.001）。平均知识评分为2.8 ± 1.3（Cronbach's α = 0.50）。较高的教育程度和女性性别与更高的知识相关，而年龄与知识呈负相关。结论：尽管自我报告的依从性高，但接受AF抗凝治疗的患者仍存在大量知识缺口，特别是在副作用和药物或食物相互作用方面。针对性的、对健康素养敏感的教育策略可能会改善接受AF抗凝治疗患者的用药安全和临床结局。

title: Indication Phenotypes and Short-Term Clinical Outcomes in Patients Undergoing Left Atrial Appendage Closure: A Single-Center Real-World Experience from Türkiye
summary: OBJECTIVE: Left atrial appendage occlusion (LAAO) is widely used for stroke prevention in patients with atrial fibrillation who are unsuitable for long‑term anticoagulation. However, whether clinical outcomes differ according to indication phenotype (bleeding‑dominant versus ischemic‑dominant) remains unclear. This study aimed to evaluate the association between indication phenotype and clinical outcomes following LAAO and to determine whether phenotype provides incremental prognostic value beyond traditional risk factors. METHOD: In this retrospective single‑center study, patients undergoing LAAO were classified as having either a bleeding‑dominant or ischemic‑dominant indication phenotype. The primary outcome was all‑cause mortality. The secondary outcome was a net clinical benefit composite consisting of death, recurrent stroke, or major bleeding. Associations were assessed using Kaplan-Meier and Cox analyses, and the proportional hazards assumption was tested using Schoenfeld residuals. Sensitivity analyses were performed after excluding major bleeding from the composite outcome. RESULTS: A total of 109 consecutive patients were included. During a median follow‑up of approximately 10 months, all‑cause mortality occurred in 25.7% of patients, while the net clinical benefit composite occurred in 29.4%. No statistically significant association was observed between indication phenotype and mortality (adjusted hazard ratio [HR] 1.00, 95% confidence interval [CI] 0.38-2.62) or the composite outcome (adjusted HR 0.73, 95% CI 0.30-1.78). However, the wide confidence intervals reflect the limited sample size and event burden. CONCLUSION: Among patients undergoing LAAO, no statistically significant differences in short‑ term clinical outcomes were observed according to indication phenotype. Age emerged as the most consistent determinant of risk. Given the modest sample size, limited number of events, and relatively short follow‑up duration, these findings should be interpreted cautiously and considered hypothesis‑generating.
journal: Turk Kardiyoloji Dernegi Arsivi-Archives of the Turkish Society of Cardiology

AI.tldr: 单中心109例左心耳封堵患者中，出血主导型与缺血主导型适应证表型在约10个月随访内的全因死亡及净临床获益复合终点上无显著差异，年龄是最一致的风险决定因素。
AI.motivation: 左心耳封堵广泛用于不适合长期抗凝的房颤患者卒中预防，但适应证表型（出血主导型 vs 缺血主导型）是否影响封堵后临床结局尚不明确，且表型能否在传统危险因素之外提供增量预后价值亦缺乏证据。
AI.method: 回顾性单中心研究，连续纳入109例接受左心耳封堵的患者，按适应证分为出血主导型与缺血主导型。主要终点为全因死亡，次要终点为净临床获益复合终点（死亡、复发性卒中或大出血）。采用Kaplan-Meier与Cox回归分析关联，以Schoenfeld残差检验比例风险假设，并将大出血从复合终点中剔除后进行敏感性分析。
AI.result: 中位随访约10个月，全因死亡发生率为25.7%，净临床获益复合终点发生率为29.4%。适应证表型与全因死亡无显著关联（校正HR 1.00，95%CI 0.38-2.62），与复合终点亦无显著关联（校正HR 0.73，95%CI 0.30-1.78）。置信区间较宽，反映样本量与事件数有限。年龄为最一致的风险决定因素。
AI.conclusion: 左心耳封堵患者中，不同适应证表型的短期临床结局无统计学显著差异，年龄是最一致的风险决定因素。鉴于样本量小、事件数少且随访较短，结果应谨慎解读，属假设生成性研究，尚不足以据此改变基于表型的患者选择或术后管理策略。

summary_zh:
目的：左心耳封堵（LAAO）广泛用于不适合长期抗凝的房颤患者的卒中预防。然而，临床结局是否因适应证表型（出血主导型与缺血主导型）而异仍不清楚。本研究旨在评估LAAO后适应证表型与临床结局之间的关联，并确定表型是否在传统危险因素之外提供增量预后价值。

方法：在这项回顾性单中心研究中，接受LAAO的患者被分类为出血主导型或缺血主导型适应证表型。主要结局为全因死亡。次要结局为净临床获益复合终点，包括死亡、复发性卒中或大出血。使用Kaplan-Meier和Cox分析评估关联，并使用Schoenfeld残差检验比例风险假设。在从复合结局中排除大出血后进行敏感性分析。

结果：共纳入109例连续患者。在中位随访约10个月期间，全因死亡发生于25.7%的患者，而净临床获益复合终点发生于29.4%。未观察到适应证表型与死亡率（校正风险比[HR] 1.00，95%置信区间[CI] 0.38-2.62）或复合结局（校正HR 0.73，95% CI 0.30-1.78）之间存在统计学显著关联。然而，宽泛的置信区间反映了有限的样本量和事件负担。

结论：在接受LAAO的患者中，未观察到根据适应证表型在短期临床结局方面存在统计学显著差异。年龄成为最一致的风险决定因素。鉴于样本量适中、事件数量有限且随访时间相对较短，这些发现应谨慎解读并视为产生假设。

title: Reclassifying Ablation Energy Risk Profiles in Atrial Fibrillation A Narrative-Adjudicated Comparative Analysis of the MAUDE Database
summary: ABSTRACT Background Pulsed field ablation (PFA) has been rapidly adopted for atrial fibrillation (AF) on the premise of greater safety than thermal ablation. Real-world signals of hemolysis, coronary spasm, and neurologic events have since emerged, and prior Manufacturer and User Facility Device Experience (MAUDE) analyses relied on term matching without prospective signal detection. Methods We queried MAUDE for AF ablation catheter reports received January 2016 through June 2026 and assigned each to PFA, radiofrequency ablation (RFA), or cryoballoon ablation. We adjudicated injury and death narratives into predefined complication families and severity tiers with a large language model, checked against a larger model and by physician review. We calculated reporting odds ratios (ROR) and Bayesian shrinkage estimators compared against an empirical null, applied interrupted time series and prospective sequential detection, and repeated estimates on a 2026 hold-out. Results Among 44,623 reports, 30.1% were PFA, 50.9% RFA, and 19.0% cryoballoon, with 91.8% model agreement on event occurrence ( κ = 0.83). PFA carried an ROR of 527 (95% CI, 33, 8,509) for hemolysis, 2.83 (2.55, 3.16) for arrhythmia, 2.83 (2.30, 3.48) for coronary, and 2.39 (2.10, 2.73) for cerebrovascular events, against 0.024 (0.008, 0.075) for esophageal and 0.34 (0.32, 0.37) for pericardial events. The cerebrovascular excess was largest for VARIPULSE, but without it the class proportional reporting ratio was 1.36 (1.13, 1.65), concordant with the 1.56 measured in EMBOL-AF . In the hold-out, the cerebrovascular, arrhythmia and hemolysis signals replicated, and coronary events kept their direction without meeting the signal rule. Prospective detection flagged cerebrovascular events 13 months before AVANT GUARD published its neurologic events. Conclusions PFA showed disproportionate reporting of hemolysis, cerebrovascular, coronary, and arrhythmic events across sequential testing. Machine learning methods allowed for flagging these signals months before confirmatory trials, demonstrating a scalable tool for early detection of procedural risk. CLINICAL PERSPECTIVE What is Known Pulsed field ablation has been adopted rapidly for atrial fibrillation on the premise of fewer collateral injuries than thermal ablation. Hemolysis, coronary spasm, and neurologic events have since emerged in case series, registries, and a paused trial, while prior analyses of Food and Drug Administration device reports relied largely on term matching without narrative adjudication at scale. What the Study Adds In injury and death reports adjudicated at the narrative level, pulsed field ablation was reported more often than thermal ablation for hemolysis, arrhythmia, coronary, and cerebrovascular events and less often for esophageal and pericardial injury. The cerebrovascular reporting excess was largest for the VARIPULSE catheter but persisted with that platform removed and concentrated in minor stroke and systemic embolism, suggesting an embolic signal not confined to one platform. Sequential detection run on reports adjudicated by a large language model would have flagged the cerebrovascular signal 13 months before AVANT GUARD published its neurologic events, suggesting a role for automated surveillance of new ablation technologies.

AI.tldr: 基于MAUDE数据库的叙述性裁定分析显示，脉冲场消融（PFA）相比热消融报告了更多溶血、脑血管、冠状动脉和心律失常事件，而食管和心包事件较少，且机器学习方法可提前13个月预警脑血管信号。
AI.motivation: PFA因安全性优于热消融而被快速采纳，但真实世界中出现溶血、冠状动脉痉挛和神经系统事件信号；既往MAUDE分析依赖术语匹配，缺乏前瞻性信号检测和大规模叙述裁定。
AI.method: 回顾性比较分析，查询MAUDE数据库2016年1月至2026年6月的AF消融导管报告，分为PFA、RFA和冷冻球囊三组。使用大语言模型对损伤和死亡叙述进行裁定，归入预定义并发症家族和严重程度层级，并经更大模型和医生复核。计算报告比值比（ROR）和贝叶斯收缩估计量，应用中断时间序列和前瞻性序贯检测，并在2026年留出集上重复估计。
AI.result: 共44,623份报告，PFA占30.1%，RFA占50.9%，冷冻球囊占19.0%，模型对事件发生的一致性为91.8%（κ=0.83）。PFA的ROR：溶血527（95%CI 33-8509），心律失常2.83（2.55-3.16），冠状动脉事件2.83（2.30-3.48），脑血管事件2.39（2.10-2.73）；食管事件0.024（0.008-0.075），心包事件0.34（0.32-0.37）。脑血管超额报告在VARIPULSE最大，但去除后类别比例报告比为1.36（1.13-1.65），与EMBOL-AF的1.56一致。留出集中脑血管、心律失常和溶血信号重现，冠状动脉事件方向一致但未达信号规则。前瞻性检测在AVANT GUARD发表神经事件前13个月即标记脑血管信号。
AI.conclusion: PFA在序贯检测中显示溶血、脑血管、冠状动脉和心律失常事件的报告比例过高，而食管和心包损伤报告较少。机器学习方法可在确证性试验前数月标记信号，为新技术早期风险监测提供可扩展工具。局限性包括依赖自发报告数据库、可能存在报告偏倚，且部分信号未在留出集中完全重现。

summary_zh:
摘要

背景：脉冲场消融（PFA）基于比热消融更安全的假设，已被快速应用于心房颤动（AF）的治疗。此后，出现了溶血、冠状动脉痉挛和神经系统事件的真实世界信号，而既往对制造商与用户设施设备体验（MAUDE）数据库的分析依赖于术语匹配，未进行前瞻性信号检测。

方法：我们查询了MAUDE数据库中2016年1月至2026年6月收到的AF消融导管报告，并将每份报告归为PFA、射频消融（RFA）或冷冻球囊消融。我们使用大语言模型将损伤和死亡叙述判定为预定义的并发症类别和严重程度层级，并用更大的模型进行核对以及由医生审核。我们计算了报告比值比（ROR）和贝叶斯收缩估计量，与经验零假设进行比较，应用了中断时间序列和前瞻性序贯检测，并在2026年的留出集上重复了估计。

结果：在44,623份报告中，30.1%为PFA，50.9%为RFA，19.0%为冷冻球囊，事件发生率的模型一致率为91.8%（κ = 0.83）。PFA的ROR为：溶血527（95% CI，33，8,509），心律失常2.83（2.55，3.16），冠状动脉事件2.83（2.30，3.48），脑血管事件2.39（2.10，2.73），而食管事件为0.024（0.008，0.075），心包事件为0.34（0.32，0.37）。脑血管事件超额在VARIPULSE中最大，但去除该平台后，类别比例报告比为1.36（1.13，1.65），与EMBOL-AF中测得的1.56一致。在留出集中，脑血管、心律失常和溶血信号得到重复，冠状动脉事件保持方向但未满足信号规则。前瞻性检测在AVANT GUARD发表其神经系统事件之前13个月即标记出脑血管事件。

结论：PFA在序贯检测中显示出溶血、脑血管、冠状动脉和心律失常事件的不成比例报告。机器学习方法使得在验证性试验数月前标记这些信号成为可能，展示了一种可扩展的工具，用于早期检测手术风险。

临床视角

已知内容：脉冲场消融基于比热消融更少的附带损伤的假设，已被快速应用于心房颤动。此后，溶血、冠状动脉痉挛和神经系统事件在病例系列、注册研究和一项暂停的试验中出现，而既往对食品药品监督管理局器械报告的分析主要依赖于术语匹配，未进行大规模的叙述判定。

本研究新增内容：在叙述层面判定的损伤和死亡报告中，脉冲场消融相比热消融更常报告溶血、心律失常、冠状动脉和脑血管事件，而较少报告食管和心包损伤。脑血管报告超额在VARIPULSE导管中最大，但在去除该平台后仍持续存在，并集中于轻微卒中和系统性栓塞，提示栓塞信号不局限于单一平台。基于大语言模型判定报告运行的序贯检测，会在AVANT GUARD发表其神经系统事件之前13个月标记出脑血管信号，提示自动化监测在新消融技术中可能发挥作用。

title: Reliability and accuracy of medication-based performance measures for assessment of outpatient cardiology clinicians
summary: Background: Multiple performance measures are used to assess the management of common cardiovascular conditions, such as coronary artery disease (CAD), heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF), and atrial fibrillation (AF). These measures are sometimes used to assess individual clinicians, despite lack of evidence of reliability and accuracy. We used national Veteran Affairs (VA) data to test medication-based performance measures for assessment of clinician performance in outpatient cardiology care. Methods: This retrospective study examined VA cardiology clinician/Veteran dyads from 2017-2023 to evaluate 10 medication-based performance measures for CAD, HFrEF, or AF with elevated stroke risk. Achievement of each performance measure was defined as an active prescription of an indicated medication for each eligible patient encounter, summarized at the clinician level. Reliability was calculated using the beta-binomial method. A Bayesian causal model was used to assess the impact of case complexity on performance measure achievement. Finally, we performed peer review of a subset of cases (n = 952) to assess the accuracy of three representative performance measures. Results: Of 456,071 unique cardiology encounters included in this study, 312,331 included CAD, 224,599 included HFrEF, and 178,678 included AF. These patients were treated by 1,043 cardiology clinicians. Median performance measure achievement ranged from 0.23 (SGLT2i for HFrEF) to 0.99 (beta blocker for HFrEF). Measure reliability varied from 0.63 to 0.90. Case complexity did not significantly affect performance measure achievement. Using peer review as the gold standard, accuracy was poor to moderate (balanced accuracy 0.51-0.73), and measures underestimated performance relative to peer review. Conclusions: Ten medication-based performance measures for CAD, HFrEF, and AF can be efficiently measured using electronic health record data, and most have sufficient reliability to support clinician benchmarking and the identification of potential care gaps without need for risk adjustment. However, suboptimal accuracy compared with a peer review gold standard indicates that these measures may be insufficient as a standalone assessment of clinician quality.

AI.tldr: 基于VA电子健康记录评估门诊心内科医生的10项药物绩效指标，多数可靠性足够（0.63-0.90）且病例复杂度无显著影响，但与同行评议金标准相比准确性仅差至中等（平衡准确度0.51-0.73），提示这些指标不宜单独用于医生质量评价。
AI.motivation: 多种药物绩效指标被用于评估冠心病、射血分数降低的心力衰竭和房颤等常见心血管疾病的诊疗管理，甚至用于个体医生评价，但缺乏可靠性和准确性的证据。本研究旨在利用全国退伍军人事务部数据检验这些指标在门诊心内科医生评估中的表现。
AI.method: 回顾性研究，纳入2017-2023年VA心内科医生与退伍军人患者配对数据，评估10项针对冠心病、HFrEF或卒中风险升高的房颤的药物治疗绩效指标。指标达成定义为每次合格就诊时患者有适应药物的活跃处方，并在医生层面汇总。采用β-二项法计算可靠性，贝叶斯因果模型评估病例复杂度对指标达成的影响，并对952例次进行同行评议以评估三项代表性指标的准确性。
AI.result: 共纳入456,071次独特心内科就诊（冠心病312,331次、HFrEF 224,599次、房颤178,678次），由1,043名心内科医生诊治。指标达成率中位数从0.23（HFrEF使用SGLT2i）到0.99（HFrEF使用β受体阻滞剂）。可靠性范围为0.63至0.90。病例复杂度对指标达成无显著影响。以同行评议为金标准，准确性差至中等（平衡准确度0.51-0.73），且指标相对于同行评议低估了表现。
AI.conclusion: 10项基于药物的绩效指标可通过电子健康记录数据高效测量，多数具有足够可靠性支持医生基准比较和识别潜在诊疗差距，且无需风险调整。然而，与同行评议金标准相比准确性欠佳，表明这些指标可能不足以作为医生质量的单独评估工具。对电生理实践而言，房颤相关指标（如抗凝治疗）需谨慎解读，应结合其他质量评估方法。

summary_zh:
背景：多种绩效指标被用于评估常见心血管疾病的管理，如冠状动脉疾病（CAD）、射血分数降低的心力衰竭（HFrEF）和心房颤动（AF）。尽管缺乏可靠性和准确性的证据，这些指标有时仍被用于评估个体临床医生。我们使用全国退伍军人事务部（VA）的数据来检验基于药物的绩效指标在评估门诊心脏病学诊疗中临床医生绩效方面的表现。

方法：这项回顾性研究检查了2017年至2023年VA心脏病学临床医生/退伍军人配对，以评估针对CAD、HFrEF或伴有卒中风险升高的AF的10项基于药物的绩效指标。每项绩效指标的达成定义为对每位符合条件的患者就诊开具适应症药物的有效处方，并在临床医生层面进行汇总。可靠性使用β-二项方法计算。使用贝叶斯因果模型评估病例复杂性对绩效指标达成的影响。最后，我们对一部分病例（n = 952）进行了同行评审，以评估三项代表性绩效指标的准确性。

结果：本研究纳入的456,071次独特心脏病学就诊中，312,331次涉及CAD，224,599次涉及HFrEF，178,678次涉及AF。这些患者由1,043名心脏病学临床医生治疗。绩效指标达成率的中位数范围为0.23（HFrEF使用SGLT2i）至0.99（HFrEF使用β受体阻滞剂）。指标可靠性范围为0.63至0.90。病例复杂性未显著影响绩效指标的达成。以同行评审为金标准，准确性为差至中等（平衡准确性0.51-0.73），且指标相对于同行评审低估了绩效。

结论：针对CAD、HFrEF和AF的10项基于药物的绩效指标可以使用电子健康记录数据高效测量，且大多数具有足够的可靠性，可支持临床医生基准比较和识别潜在诊疗差距，而无需风险调整。然而，与同行评审金标准相比，准确性欠佳表明这些指标可能不足以作为临床医生质量的独立评估。

title: Clinical features of atrial fibrillation in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus
summary: Atrial fibrillation (AF) and type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) are among the most common chronic diseases. Their coexistence is associated with an increased risk of cardiovascular complications and an unfavorable clinical prognosis, which underscores the need to study the impact of carbohydrate metabolism disorders on the clinical course of AF. Purpose: Assessment of the relationship between the presence of type 2 diabetes mellitus, the duration of the disease, the quality of glycemic control, and the clinical features of atrial fibrillation in patients with a combination of these diseases. Materials and methods: This retrospective observational study included 1,307 patients with AF who were hospitalized between 2020 and 2025. The patients were divided into two groups: AF without T2DM (433 patients) and AF combined with T2DM (874 patients). In the T2DM group, additional stratification was performed according to achievement of target glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c) levels, disease duration, presence of diabetic micro- and macroangiopathy, thrombotic complications, and the type of glucose-lowering therapy. The clinical forms of AF, frequency and duration of arrhythmia episodes, as well as the frequency and length of hospitalizations were assessed. Results and discussion: The study demonstrated that the presence of T2DM is associated with a more severe clinical course of AF. Patients with T2DM more frequently exhibited persistent, long-standing persistent, and permanent forms of arrhythmia. They also showed an increased frequency and duration of AF episodes, a higher need for inpatient treatment, and longer hospital stays. Failure to achieve target HbA1c levels was associated with a higher frequency of arrhythmia episodes, increased hospitalization rates, and prolonged inpatient stays. The most unfavorable disease course was observed in patients with a T2DM duration of more than 10 years and in those with chronic microvascular and macrovascular complications. The combination of AF and T2DM complicated by thrombotic events was characterized by the highest frequency and longest duration of arrhythmia episodes, as well as the longest hospitalization periods. Conclusions: Thus, the study results highlight the key role of T2DM and its associated cardiovascular complications in the development of an unfavorable course of AF and substantiate the need for a comprehensive management approach in this patient population.

AI.tldr: 回顾性研究纳入1307例房颤住院患者，合并2型糖尿病者房颤临床病程更重，血糖控制不达标、病程超10年及合并微血管/大血管并发症者心律失常发作更频繁、住院更多更久。
AI.motivation: 房颤与2型糖尿病均为常见慢性病，二者共存与心血管并发症风险升高及不良预后相关，但糖代谢紊乱对房颤临床病程的具体影响（尤其血糖控制质量、糖尿病病程及并发症的作用）尚缺乏系统评估，本研究旨在填补这一缺口。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性观察性研究，纳入2020—2025年间住院的1307例房颤患者，分为单纯房颤组（433例）与房颤合并2型糖尿病组（874例）；糖尿病组进一步按HbA1c是否达标、糖尿病病程、有无糖尿病微血管/大血管病变、血栓并发症及降糖治疗方案分层。评估指标为房颤临床类型、心律失常发作频率与持续时间、住院次数及住院时长。摘要未报告具体统计方法与校正混杂因素的方式。
AI.result: 合并2型糖尿病者持续性、长程持续性及永久性房颤更常见，房颤发作频率更高、持续时间更长，住院需求更高且住院时间更长。HbA1c未达标与心律失常发作更频繁、住院率升高及住院时间延长相关。病程超过10年及合并慢性微血管、大血管并发症者病程最不利；房颤合并2型糖尿病并发生血栓事件者心律失常发作频率最高、持续时间最长、住院时间最久。摘要未报告各比较的具体效应量、95%CI及P值。
AI.conclusion: 2型糖尿病及其相关心血管并发症在房颤不良病程中起关键作用，提示对该共病人群需采取综合管理策略，包括强化血糖控制、关注糖尿病病程与并发症筛查，并加强房颤节律与住院风险管理。局限性为单中心回顾性设计、缺乏具体效应量与统计校正信息，结论需前瞻性研究验证。

summary_zh:
背景：心房颤动（AF）和2型糖尿病（T2DM）是最常见的慢性疾病之一。两者共存与心血管并发症风险增加和不良临床预后相关，这强调需要研究碳水化合物代谢紊乱对AF临床病程的影响。

目的：评估2型糖尿病的存在、病程长短、血糖控制质量与心房颤动临床特征之间的关系，在同时患有这两种疾病的患者中。

材料与方法：这项回顾性观察研究纳入了2020年至2025年间住院的1,307例AF患者。患者被分为两组：无T2DM的AF组（433例）和合并T2DM的AF组（874例）。在T2DM组中，根据是否达到目标糖化血红蛋白（HbA1c）水平、疾病持续时间、是否存在糖尿病微血管和大血管病变、血栓并发症以及降糖治疗类型进行了进一步分层。评估了AF的临床类型、心律失常发作的频率和持续时间，以及住院的频率和时长。

结果与讨论：研究表明，T2DM的存在与AF更严重的临床病程相关。T2DM患者更频繁地表现为持续性、长程持续性和永久性心律失常。他们还表现出AF发作频率和持续时间增加、住院治疗需求更高以及住院时间更长。未达到目标HbA1c水平与心律失常发作频率更高、住院率增加和住院时间延长相关。疾病病程最不利的是T2DM病程超过10年的患者以及伴有慢性微血管和大血管并发症的患者。AF合并T2DM并发血栓事件的组合以心律失常发作频率最高、持续时间最长以及住院时间最长为特征。

结论：因此，研究结果突显了T2DM及其相关心血管并发症在AF不良病程发展中的关键作用，并证实了在该患者群体中需要综合管理方法。

title: Relationship between paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and the Osaka Prognostic Score.
summary:
BACKGROUND: The Osaka Prognostic Score (OPS), which is based on C‑reactive protein (CRP), total lymphocyte count (TLC), and albumin (ALB), has been reported to have prognostic value in several types of cancer. Recent studies have revealed a relationship between the OPS and cardiovascular diseases. The aim of this study was to evaluate the relationship between the OPS and paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (AF), a significant rhythm disorder.

METHODS: A total of 941 individuals, including 198 patients with a history of AF and 743 patients without AF as the control group, were included in the study. These groups were compared in terms of demographic characteristics and laboratory findings.

RESULTS: Univariable and multivariable binary logistic regression analyses revealed an independent relationship between the OPS and AF (odds ratio [OR]: 3.37, p < 0.001). In receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve analysis, OPS above a cut-off level of 0.5 was associated with the presence of AF, with a sensitivity of 55.6% and a specificity of 77.4% (area under the ROC curve [AUC]: 0.682, p < 0.001).

CONCLUSION: This study found a relationship between the OPS and paroxysmal AF attacks. The OPS may provide additional information for the clinical evaluation of patients with paroxysmal AF in daily practice.

AI.tldr: 在941例受试者中，大阪预后评分（OPS）与阵发性房颤独立相关（OR 3.37，P<0.001），但作为诊断指标的区分度有限（AUC 0.682）。
AI.motivation: OPS基于C反应蛋白、总淋巴细胞计数和白蛋白计算，最初在多种肿瘤中显示预后价值，近年被发现与心血管疾病相关；但其与阵发性房颤的关系尚缺乏研究，临床上也缺少简便的炎症-营养复合指标用于房颤风险评估。
AI.method: 单中心病例对照研究，共纳入941例，其中198例有房颤病史（房颤组），743例无房颤者为对照组；比较两组人口学特征与实验室检查结果，采用单因素及多因素二元logistic回归分析OPS与房颤的独立关系，并以ROC曲线评估OPS对房颤的判别能力，确定最佳截断值、敏感度与特异度。
AI.result: 多因素二元logistic回归显示OPS与房颤独立相关（OR 3.37，P<0.001）。ROC分析中，OPS>0.5与房颤存在相关，敏感度55.6%、特异度77.4%，AUC 0.682（P<0.001）。摘要未报告OR的95%置信区间，也未报告两组基线特征及各项实验室指标的具体数值。
AI.conclusion: OPS与阵发性房颤发作存在独立关联，可能为日常实践中阵发性房颤患者的临床评估提供补充信息；但其判别能力中等（AUC 0.682），且为病例对照设计，无法推断因果关系，OPS能否用于房颤筛查或风险分层尚需前瞻性队列研究验证。

summary_zh:
背景：大阪预后评分（Osaka Prognostic Score, OPS）基于C反应蛋白（CRP）、总淋巴细胞计数（TLC）和白蛋白（ALB），已被报道在多种癌症中具有预后价值。近期研究揭示了OPS与心血管疾病之间的关系。本研究旨在评估OPS与阵发性心房颤动（AF）——一种重要的节律紊乱——之间的关系。

方法：本研究共纳入941例个体，包括198例有AF病史的患者和743例无AF的患者作为对照组。对这些组的人口学特征和实验室检查结果进行了比较。

结果：单变量和多变量二元logistic回归分析显示OPS与AF之间存在独立关系（比值比[OR]：3.37，p < 0.001）。在受试者工作特征（ROC）曲线分析中，OPS高于0.5的截断水平与AF的存在相关，敏感性为55.6%，特异性为77.4%（ROC曲线下面积[AUC]：0.682，p < 0.001）。

结论：本研究发现OPS与阵发性AF发作之间存在关系。OPS可能为日常实践中阵发性AF患者的临床评估提供额外信息。

title: Integrated care management and comprehensive geriatric assessment using a mHealth-based approach in older multimorbid patients with atrial fibrillation: the AFFIRMO cluster-randomised trial.
summary:
BACKGROUND: The AFFIRMO trial aimed to evaluate the efficacy of a mobile-health (mHealth) structured intervention adapting the Atrial Fibrillation Better Care (ABC) pathway, combining the comprehensive geriatric assessment (CGA), to enhance guideline-directed, holistic AF management and reduce the risk of clinical outcomes in older patients with atrial fibrillation (AF) and multimorbidity.

METHODS: In a multicentre, open-label, cluster-randomised study conducted in six European countries, clusters were allocated to usual care or intervention (iABC system) (ClinicalTrials.govNCT06775028, https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT06775028). In usual care clusters, patients were managed according to clinical guidelines.

FINDINGS: We enrolled 1260 patients (mean [SD] age 74 [6] years; 44.4% (560/1260) female; median CHA2DS2-VASc 4 [IQR 3-5]), with 634 (50.3%) assigned to intervention and 626 (49.7%) to usual care. Overall, 41.0% (517/1260) had >2 comorbidities, with a high prevalence of anticoagulation (1226, 97.3%) and guideline-recommended therapies. CGA in the intervention arm documented a highly preserved function. The primary endpoint of all-cause unplanned hospitalisation occurred in 108 (17.1%) and 114 (18.2%) patients in the intervention and usual care groups [adjusted OR 0.95, 95% CI 0.61-1.49; p = 0.84]. Use of the AFFIRMO Mobile App was suboptimal, with 68.5% (433/632) of patients using it for only one-third of the observation time.

INTERPRETATION: In a setting of high baseline guideline adherence and low event rates, the iABC system did not reduce unplanned hospitalisations compared with usual care. These findings suggest no incremental benefit of mHealth integrated care interventions when applied to optimally managed populations, particularly in the context of suboptimal intervention uptake.

FUNDING: European Union's Horizon 2020 Research and Innovation Program (grant agreement 899871).

AI.tldr: 在基线指南依从性高、事件率低的老年多病共存AF患者中，基于mHealth的iABC整合管理未减少全因非计划住院（17.1% vs 18.2%，调整OR 0.95，P=0.84）。
AI.motivation: ABC路径可改善AF管理，但mHealth结合老年综合评估（CGA）在老年多病共存AF患者中的疗效证据有限，AFFIRMO试验旨在评估其能否减少临床不良结局。
AI.method: 多中心、开放标签、整群随机试验，6个欧洲国家，纳入1260例老年AF合并多病共存患者（平均年龄74岁，女性44.4%，中位CHA2DS2-VASc 4分），干预组634例接受基于mHealth的iABC系统（整合ABC路径与CGA），对照组626例接受常规指南管理；主要终点为全因非计划住院。
AI.result: 主要终点在干预组和对照组分别发生108例（17.1%）和114例（18.2%），调整OR 0.95（95%CI 0.61-1.49），P=0.84；68.5%的患者仅使用AFFIRMO移动应用约三分之一的观察时间。
AI.conclusion: 在指南依从性高、事件率低的优化管理人群中，iABC系统未减少非计划住院，且干预依从性欠佳；提示mHealth整合管理在已优化治疗人群中增量获益有限，需在依从性更低或管理欠佳人群中进一步验证。

summary_zh:
背景：AFFIRMO 试验旨在评估一种基于移动健康（mHealth）的结构化干预措施的疗效，该干预措施改编自心房颤动更好照护（ABC）路径，并结合了综合老年评估（CGA），以增强指南导向的整体房颤管理并降低老年房颤（AF）合并多病患者临床结局的风险。

方法：在一项在六个欧洲国家开展的多中心、开放标签、整群随机研究中，各整群被分配至常规照护或干预（iABC 系统）（ClinicalTrials.gov NCT06775028，https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT06775028）。在常规照护整群中，患者按临床指南进行管理。
