title: Cardiac Pacing and ICDs
summary: The fully updated trusted clinical guide to pacemakers, ICDs, and CRTs Now in its Eighth Edition, Cardiac Pacing and ICDs remains an essential clinically focused guide to cardiac implantable electronic devices. Authored by Kenneth A. Ellenbogen, a past President of the Heart Rhythm Society, and Karoly Kaszala, Director of Electrophysiology at the McGuire VA Medical Center in Richmond, Virginia, this edition is comprehensively updated to reflect current best practices and the latest research in cardiac pacing and defibrillation therapy. Chapters proceed from pacing basics and indications through initial patient presentation, device implantation, troubleshooting, and long-term follow-up, mirroring the clinician’s workflow. A larger format improves the viewing of images and flowcharts, as well as tables, charts, and figures. The book covers: Tips and techniques for implantation and removal of devices and left ventricular leads Pacemaker timing cycles, special features, and practical diagnostic approaches to device malfunctions ICD therapy and cardiac resynchronization therapy, including patient selection, programming, and follow-up MRI safety protocols and structured approaches to remote monitoring and long-term device management Indications for both temporary and permanent pacing presented alongside current evidence and updated clinical guidelines Designed for clinical cardiologists, electrophysiologists, cardiology fellows, EP nurses, device technicians, and industry professionals, Cardiac Pacing and ICDs delivers the practical, patient-centric guidance needed to confidently manage cardiac implantable electronic devices from implantation through long-term follow-up.

AI.tldr: 《Cardiac Pacing and ICDs》第八版为器械治疗教科书，非原创研究，无样本量与终点数据，系统更新起搏、ICD与CRT的植入、程控及随访实践。
AI.motivation: 心脏植入式电子器械（起搏器、ICD、CRT）的植入、程控与长期随访技术快速演进，临床医生需要与现行指南和最新研究同步的实用参考；既往版本已不能完全反映当前最佳实践，故推出第八版。
AI.method: 本书为临床教科书而非临床研究，摘要未报告研究类型、研究对象、样本量、干预或暴露、终点定义及统计方法；内容按临床工作流程编排，涵盖起搏基础与适应证、患者初始评估、器械植入、故障排查与长期随访，并涉及左室导线植入与拔除技巧、起搏器时间周期与特殊功能、器械故障诊断、ICD与CRT的患者选择、程控与随访、MRI安全流程及远程监测。
AI.result: 摘要未报告任何定量结果、效应量、95%置信区间或P值；仅说明本版为全面更新，采用更大开本以改善图像、流程图、表格与图表的可读性，目标读者为临床心脏科医生、电生理医生、心脏科进修医生、电生理护士、器械技师及行业人员。
AI.conclusion: 本书定位为以患者为中心、覆盖植入至长期随访全流程的实用器械治疗参考书，可用于规范起搏、ICD与CRT的临床管理；但作为教科书，其结论不来自原始研究数据，摘要未报告证据等级与定量疗效，临床决策仍需结合原始研究与现行指南。

summary_zh:
背景：作为起搏器、ICD和CRT的值得信赖的临床指南，现已全面更新。《心脏起搏与ICD》第八版仍然是心脏植入式电子设备必不可少的以临床为重点的指南。

方法：本书由心律学会前主席Kenneth A. Ellenbogen和弗吉尼亚州里士满McGuire VA医疗中心电生理主任Karoly Kaszala撰写，本版经过全面更新，以反映当前最佳实践和心脏起搏与除颤治疗的最新研究。

结果：各章节从起搏基础知识和适应证开始，经过患者初次就诊、设备植入、故障排除和长期随访，与临床医生的工作流程相呼应。更大的开本改善了图像和流程图以及表格、图表和图形的查看效果。本书涵盖：设备和左心室导线植入与移除的技巧和技术；起搏器定时周期、特殊功能以及设备故障的实用诊断方法；ICD治疗和心脏再同步治疗，包括患者选择、程控和随访；MRI安全方案以及远程监测和长期设备管理的结构化方法；临时和永久起搏的适应证，并附有当前证据和更新的临床指南。

结论：《心脏起搏与ICD》专为临床心脏病学家、电生理学家、心脏病学研究员、电生理护士、设备技术人员和行业专业人士设计，提供实用的、以患者为中心的指导，帮助自信地从植入到长期随访管理心脏植入式电子设备。

title: Automated ECG Arrhythmia Detection and Classification Using Deep Convolutional and Residual Neural Networks
summary: Cardiac arrhythmias are common and clinically significant manifestations of cardiovascular disease, yet reliable automated detection from ECG remains challenging. An automated ECG analysis system was developed to detect arrhythmia and classify it into five clinical categories. The detection model achieved 99.63% sensitivity and 98.91% specificity, while classification reached 97.85% accuracy. Detection used a shallow 1-D CNN with 188-sample windows after bandpass filtering (0.5–40 Hz) and R-peak localization. Classification used a four-block ResNet with attention and global average pooling to identify Normal beats, APB, LBBB/RBBB, Paced beats, and PVC. Evaluation on the MIT-BIH dataset (48 recordings, 109,446 beats) and PTB-XL dataset (21,799 recordings) showed improved performance over rule-based methods. The beat-level classifier achieved F1-scores of 0.99 for Normal and LBBB/RBBB, 1.00 for Paced beats, and 0.98 for PVC. Additional modules included VF detection (99.28% accuracy) and LVH screening (AUC 0.918), supporting broader cardiac assessment from a single ECG recording.
journal: Advances in computational intelligence and robotics book series

AI.tldr: 基于深度卷积和残差神经网络的心电图分析系统在MIT-BIH和PTB-XL数据集上实现了高精度的房性早搏、束支传导阻滞、起搏心搏和室性早搏检测与分类，并支持室颤检测和左心室肥厚筛查。
AI.motivation: 心律失常是心血管疾病的常见表现，但基于心电图的可靠自动检测仍具挑战性，既往基于规则的方法性能有限，需要更精准的自动化工具辅助临床评估。
AI.method: 开发自动化心电图分析系统，检测模型采用浅层一维CNN（带通滤波0.5–40 Hz，R峰定位，188样本窗口），分类模型采用四块ResNet（注意力机制和全局平均池化），将心搏分为正常、房性早搏、左/右束支传导阻滞、起搏心搏和室性早搏五类。在MIT-BIH数据集（48条记录，109,446个心搏）和PTB-XL数据集（21,799条记录）上评估，并与基于规则的方法比较。
AI.result: 检测模型敏感度99.63%、特异度98.91%；分类准确率97.85%。心搏分类F1分数：正常和左/右束支传导阻滞0.99，起搏心搏1.00，室性早搏0.98。附加模块：室颤检测准确率99.28%，左心室肥厚筛查AUC 0.918。性能优于基于规则的方法。
AI.conclusion: 深度学习模型可高精度自动检测和分类心律失常，并支持室颤检测和左心室肥厚筛查，有望提升心电图分析的效率与准确性，但需在更多样化人群中进一步验证其泛化能力。

summary_zh: 心律失常是心血管疾病常见且具有临床意义的表现，然而从ECG中进行可靠的自动检测仍然具有挑战性。开发了一个自动ECG分析系统，用于检测心律失常并将其分类为五个临床类别。检测模型达到99.63%的敏感性和98.91%的特异性，而分类达到97.85%的准确率。检测使用浅层一维CNN，在带通滤波（0.5–40 Hz）和R峰定位后采用188样本窗口。分类使用带有注意力和全局平均池化的四块ResNet，以识别正常心搏、APB、LBBB/RBBB、起搏心搏和PVC。在MIT-BIH数据集（48条记录，109,446个心搏）和PTB-XL数据集（21,799条记录）上的评估显示，性能优于基于规则的方法。心搏级分类器对正常和LBBB/RBBB的F1分数为0.99，对起搏心搏为1.00，对PVC为0.98。其他模块包括VF检测（99.28%准确率）和LVH筛查（AUC 0.918），支持从单次ECG记录进行更广泛的心脏评估。

title: Thyrotoxicosis-Associated Cholestatic Jaundice in a Patient With Incidental Gallstone Disease: A Case Report and Literature Review.
summary: BACKGROUND Thyrotoxicosis is associated with well-recognized and clinically significant complications, including congestive heart failure and cardiac arrhythmias. The relationship between hyperthyroidism and hepatic dysfunction is complex, with several proposed pathophysiological mechanisms; however, direct cholestatic injury is frequently overlooked. Although mild liver enzyme elevation is common in hyperthyroidism, clinically overt jaundice is rare. Nevertheless, increasing evidence from case reports and case series suggests that thyrotoxicosis, especially Graves disease, can result in cholestatic-pattern jaundice. This temporal association is supported by substantial improvements in jaundice and liver biochemistry after antithyroid therapy. CASE REPORT A 62-year-old woman presented with a 1-month history of right upper quadrant abdominal pain, unintentional weight loss, and jaundice. Laboratory evaluation demonstrated cholestatic-pattern liver injury, and abdominal ultrasound revealed a solitary gallstone without evidence of acute or chronic cholecystitis. Abdominal computed tomography demonstrated right-sided heart failure with pericardial and bilateral pleural effusions and congestive hepatopathy. Endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography showed no filling defects, excluding biliary obstruction. Because the patient had persistent sinus tachycardia, thyroid function tests were performed. The findings were consistent with primary hyperthyroidism and elevated thyroid-stimulating hormone receptor antibodies); thyroid ultrasound and scintigraphy results supported toxic multinodular goiter. Treatment with methimazole led to dramatic improvement of the jaundice. Given the possibility of competing etiologies, thyrotoxicosis was considered the most likely contributing factor to cholestatic jaundice onset. CONCLUSIONS This case highlights the importance of considering hyperthyroidism in the differential diagnosis of jaundice, particularly in diagnostically challenging cases.

AI.tldr: 62岁女性以胆汁淤积性黄疸就诊，最终证实为甲状腺功能亢进所致，甲巯咪唑治疗后黄疸显著改善。
AI.motivation: 甲状腺功能亢进可导致心力衰竭与心律失常等并发症，但直接引起胆汁淤积性肝损伤常被忽视；甲亢患者轻度肝酶升高常见，临床显性黄疸罕见，既往证据多来自个案报告与病例系列，需提高对甲亢作为黄疸病因的识别。
AI.method: 个案报告并附文献复习。对象为62岁女性，表现为右上腹痛、非意愿性体重下降及黄疸1个月。实验室检查示胆汁淤积型肝损伤，腹部超声示单发胆囊结石但无急慢性胆囊炎证据，腹部CT示右心衰竭伴心包积液、双侧胸腔积液及淤血性肝病，ERCP未见充盈缺损、排除胆道梗阻；因持续窦性心动过速行甲状腺功能检查，结果符合原发性甲亢且TSH受体抗体升高，甲状腺超声与核素显像支持毒性多结节性甲状腺肿。干预为甲巯咪唑治疗。摘要未报告样本量以外的统计方法与终点定义。
AI.result: 甲巯咪唑治疗后黄疸显著改善。摘要未报告具体肝功能指标数值、甲状腺功能数值、随访时间及P值等统计结果。
AI.conclusion: 本病例提示在黄疸鉴别诊断中应考虑甲亢，尤其对诊断困难者；甲亢可能是胆汁淤积性黄疸的致病因素之一。作为单个病例报告，因果推断受限，需更多证据支持，但提示电生理与心衰管理中应关注甲状腺功能及其肝脏表现。

summary_zh: 背景：甲状腺毒症与公认且具有临床意义的并发症相关，包括充血性心力衰竭和心律失常。甲状腺功能亢进与肝功能障碍之间的关系复杂，有多种提出的病理生理机制；然而，直接胆汁淤积性损伤常被忽视。尽管甲状腺功能亢进中轻度肝酶升高常见，但临床明显的黄疸罕见。然而，越来越多的病例报告和病例系列证据表明，甲状腺毒症，尤其是Graves病，可导致胆汁淤积型黄疸。这种时间关联得到了抗甲状腺治疗后黄疸和肝功能生化指标显著改善的支持。病例报告：一名62岁女性，表现为1个月病史的右上腹疼痛、非自愿体重减轻和黄疸。实验室评估显示胆汁淤积型肝损伤，腹部超声显示孤立性胆结石，无急性或慢性胆囊炎证据。腹部计算机断层扫描显示右心衰竭伴心包积液和双侧胸腔积液及充血性肝病。内镜逆行胰胆管造影显示无充盈缺损，排除胆道梗阻。由于患者有持续性窦性心动过速，进行了甲状腺功能检查。结果符合原发性甲状腺功能亢进和甲状腺刺激激素受体抗体升高；甲状腺超声和闪烁扫描结果支持毒性多结节性甲状腺肿。甲巯咪唑治疗导致黄疸显著改善。鉴于存在竞争性病因的可能性，甲状腺毒症被认为是导致胆汁淤积性黄疸发作的最可能因素。结论：本病例强调了在黄疸的鉴别诊断中考虑甲状腺功能亢进的重要性，尤其是在诊断具有挑战性的病例中。

title: High lipoprotein(a) levels in patients with very high cardiovascular risk: incidence and association with other risk factors
summary: Lipoprotein(a) (Lp(a)) is a significant independent cardiovascular risk factor (CVR) associated with the development of atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (CVD), heart failure, atrial fibrillation, and increased overall and cardiovascular mortality. The aim of the study: to assess the incidence of elevated Lp(a) levels (> 75 nmol/L) in patients with very high CVR, as well as to analyze differences in clinical and laboratory characteristics and drug therapy between groups with normal and elevated Lp(a). Material and methods . A retrospective analysis of outpatient records of patients with very high CVR (n = 76, 63.2 % men, median age 61.0 [51.0; 70.0] years) who visited the Lipid Center of the Research Institute of Therapeutic, Preventive and Microbiological Medicine, a branch of the Institute of Cytology and Genetics, Siberian Branch of the Russian Academy of Sciences, Novosibirsk, from July 2025 to April 2026. All patients included in the study underwent clinical laboratory testing. Results . In the analyzed group of patients with very high CVR, the incidence of elevated Lp(a) ≥ 75 nmol/L was 38.2 %, and ≥ 125 nmol/L – 31.6 % of patients. In the group with elevated Lp(a) levels, patients were younger (55.0 [47.0; 68.5] and 64.0 [53.0; 71.0] years, p = 0.019), had earlier onset of CVD (53.5 [49.5; 60.5] and 62.0 [51.0; 66.0] years, p = 0.022), and were more likely to have a family history of CVD (89.7 % and 46.8 %, p = 0.012). In the group with elevated Lp(a) levels, higher TC (4.9 [3.4; 6.2] mmol/L vs. 4.3 [3.6; 5.9] mmol/L, p = 0.765) and LDL-C (2.6 [1.6; 3.9] mmol/L vs. 2.0 [1.5; 4.0] mmol/L) values were observed, but without reaching statistical significance (p = 0.460). The proportion of patients who achieved the target LDL-C level was low and did not differ between the groups. In patients who did not achieve the target LDL-C level, the median Lp(a) was higher (45.0 [20.0; 190.5] nmol/L) compared to patients who achieved the target LDL-C level (20.0 [20.0; 225.0] nmol/L), but the difference did not reach statistical significance (p = 0.533). Conclusions. The incidence of elevated Lp(a) levels (>75 nmol/L) in patients with very high CVD was 38.2 %. Patients with elevated Lp(a) levels are characterized by earlier onset of CVD, a positive family history, and insufficient efficacy of standard lipid-lowering therapy in reducing LDL-C.

AI.tldr: 在心血管风险极高患者中，38.2%存在Lp(a)≥75 nmol/L，该组患者发病更早、家族史更常见，但标准降脂治疗达标率低。
AI.motivation: Lp(a)是独立心血管风险因素，与动脉粥样硬化性心血管疾病、心衰、房颤及死亡相关，但极高危人群中Lp(a)升高的发生率及其与临床特征的关系尚需明确。
AI.method: 回顾性分析2025年7月至2026年4月就诊于脂质中心的极高危心血管风险患者76例（男性63.2%，中位年龄61.0岁），评估Lp(a)>75 nmol/L的发生率，并比较Lp(a)正常与升高组间的临床、实验室特征及药物治疗差异。
AI.result: Lp(a)≥75 nmol/L者占38.2%，≥125 nmol/L者占31.6%。升高组更年轻（55.0 vs 64.0岁，p=0.019）、心血管病发病更早（53.5 vs 62.0岁，p=0.022）、家族史更常见（89.7% vs 46.8%，p=0.012）。总胆固醇和LDL-C在升高组数值更高但无统计学差异（p=0.765和p=0.460）。LDL-C达标率低且两组无差异；未达标者Lp(a)中位数较高但无统计学差异（p=0.533）。
AI.conclusion: 极高危心血管病患者中Lp(a)升高发生率为38.2%，Lp(a)升高者具有发病早、家族史阳性及标准降脂治疗LDL-C达标不足的特征，提示需关注Lp(a)筛查与强化降脂策略。

summary_zh: 脂蛋白(a)（Lp(a)）是一个显著且独立的心血管风险因素（CVR），与动脉粥样硬化性心血管疾病（CVD）、心力衰竭、心房颤动以及全因和心血管死亡率的增加相关。研究目的：评估极高CVR患者中Lp(a)水平升高（> 75 nmol/L）的发生率，并分析Lp(a)正常组与升高组在临床和实验室特征及药物治疗方面的差异。材料与方法。对2025年7月至2026年4月期间在俄罗斯科学院西伯利亚分院细胞学与遗传学研究所附属治疗、预防与微生物医学研究所脂质中心就诊的极高CVR患者（n = 76，男性63.2%，中位年龄61.0 [51.0; 70.0]岁）的门诊记录进行回顾性分析。所有纳入研究的患者均接受了临床实验室检测。结果。在分析的极高CVR患者组中，Lp(a) ≥ 75 nmol/L的发生率为38.2%，≥ 125 nmol/L的发生率为31.6%。在Lp(a)水平升高组中，患者更年轻（55.0 [47.0; 68.5]岁 vs. 64.0 [53.0; 71.0]岁，p = 0.019），CVD发病更早（53.5 [49.5; 60.5]岁 vs. 62.0 [51.0; 66.0]岁，p = 0.022），且更可能有CVD家族史（89.7% vs. 46.8%，p = 0.012）。在Lp(a)水平升高组中，观察到更高的TC（4.9 [3.4; 6.2] mmol/L vs. 4.3 [3.6; 5.9] mmol/L，p = 0.765）和LDL-C（2.6 [1.6; 3.9] mmol/L vs. 2.0 [1.5; 4.0] mmol/L）值，但未达到统计学显著性（p = 0.460）。达到目标LDL-C水平的患者比例较低，且组间无差异。在未达到目标LDL-C水平的患者中，Lp(a)中位数更高（45.0 [20.0; 190.5] nmol/L），相比之下达到目标LDL-C水平的患者为（20.0 [20.0; 225.0] nmol/L），但差异未达到统计学显著性（p = 0.533）。结论。极高CVD患者中Lp(a)水平升高（>75 nmol/L）的发生率为38.2%。Lp(a)水平升高的患者特征为CVD发病更早、家族史阳性，以及标准降脂治疗在降低LDL-C方面疗效不足。

title: Sitosterolemia presenting as unexplained cytopenias: hematologic manifestations and genetic spectrum.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Sitosterolemia is a rare autosomal recessive disorder caused by pathogenic variants in the ATP-binding cassette subfamily G member 5 (ABCG5) or ATP-binding cassette subfamily G member 8 (ABCG8) gene, which increase the intestinal absorption of plant sterols and reduce their biliary excretion. It is classically linked to xanthomas and premature cardiovascular disease; however, many patients first present with haematologic abnormalities, often leading to diagnostic delay.

METHODS: We retrospectively reviewed six consecutive patients with clinical features suggestive of sitosterolemia and molecular variants in the ABCG5 or ABCG8 gene who were treated at a tertiary referral center between January 2024 and June 2026. We analyzed their clinical features, hematologic findings, genetic variants, treatment, and follow-up outcomes.

RESULTS: Six patients (three men and three women; median age, 40 years [range, 22-55 years]) presented with anemia, thrombocytopenia, and splenomegaly but were initially misdiagnosed with more common disorders, such as immune thrombocytopenia, iron-deficiency anemia, megaloblastic anemia, and Evans syndrome. All patients had stomatocytes and giant platelets on peripheral blood smears; three also had tendon xanthomas, and one had premature coronary artery disease. Genetic testing predominantly identified ABCG8 variants, as well as two ABCG5 variants, including a homozygous ABCG5 c.1724 T > G (p.Leu575Arg) variant that has not been previously reported and is currently classified as a variant of uncertain significance. All patients were advised to follow a phytosterol-restricted diet, and five received ezetimibe. Four patients with available follow-up data showed improvements in hemoglobin, platelet count, and spleen size during 4-12 months of follow-up. One patient was lost to follow-up, and one patient had insufficient follow-up for outcome assessment.

CONCLUSION: Sitosterolemia should therefore be considered in patients with unexplained cytopenias, stomatocytosis, macrothrombocytopenia, and splenomegaly. Early recognition and genetic confirmation of this condition allows timely treatment with dietary modification and ezetimibe, thereby improving hematologic outcomes and preventing unnecessary investigations.

AI.tldr: 6例谷固醇血症患者以不明原因血细胞减少起病，伴口形红细胞、巨血小板及脾大，基因检测以ABCG8变异为主，限制植物固醇饮食联合依折麦布可改善血液学指标。
AI.motivation: 谷固醇血症为ABCG5/ABCG8致病变异所致的罕见常染色体隐性遗传病，经典表现为黄色瘤和早发心血管疾病，但不少患者以血液学异常首诊，易被误诊为免疫性血小板减少、缺铁性贫血等常见病而延误诊断，需明确其血液学表现与基因谱以提升识别率。
AI.method: 回顾性研究，纳入2024年1月至2026年6月单中心连续6例具有谷固醇血症临床线索且携带ABCG5或ABCG8变异的患者（男3例、女3例，中位年龄40岁，范围22-55岁），分析临床表现、血液学指标、基因变异、治疗及随访结局；摘要未报告具体统计方法。
AI.result: 6例均表现为贫血、血小板减少和脾大，初诊被误诊为免疫性血小板减少、缺铁性贫血、巨幼细胞性贫血及Evans综合征；外周血涂片均见口形红细胞和巨血小板，3例有肌腱黄色瘤，1例早发冠心病。基因检测以ABCG8变异为主，另检出2种ABCG5变异，包括1个既往未报道的纯合ABCG5 c.1724T>G（p.Leu575Arg）变异，目前归类为意义未明变异。全部患者接受限制植物固醇饮食，5例加用依折麦布；4例有随访资料者血红蛋白、血小板计数及脾脏大小在4-12个月内改善，1例失访、1例随访不足。摘要未报告具体效应量与P值。
AI.conclusion: 对不明原因血细胞减少伴口形红细胞、巨血小板减少和脾大者应考虑谷固醇血症，早期基因确诊可及时启动饮食调整与依折麦布治疗，改善血液学结局并避免不必要检查；本研究为小样本回顾性观察，缺乏对照及定量统计，结论需更大样本验证。

summary_zh:
背景：谷固醇血症是一种罕见的常染色体隐性遗传病，由ATP结合盒亚家族G成员5（ABCG5）或ATP结合盒亚家族G成员8（ABCG8）基因的致病性变异引起，这些变异增加植物固醇的肠道吸收并减少其胆汁排泄。该病经典上与黄色瘤和早发心血管疾病相关；然而，许多患者最初表现为血液学异常，常导致诊断延迟。

方法：我们回顾性分析了2024年1月至2026年6月期间在三级转诊中心治疗的六例连续患者，这些患者具有提示谷固醇血症的临床特征和ABCG5或ABCG8基因的分子变异。我们分析了他们的临床特征、血液学发现、基因变异、治疗和随访结果。

结果：六例患者（三男三女；中位年龄40岁[范围22-55岁]）表现为贫血、血小板减少和脾肿大，但最初被误诊为更常见的疾病，如免疫性血小板减少症、缺铁性贫血、巨幼细胞性贫血和Evans综合征。所有患者外周血涂片均见口形红细胞和巨大血小板；三例还有肌腱黄色瘤，一例有早发冠状动脉疾病。基因检测主要发现ABCG8变异，以及两个ABCG5变异，包括一个此前未报道的纯合ABCG5 c.1724 T > G（p.Leu575Arg）变异，目前被归类为意义不明的变异。所有患者均被建议遵循限制植物固醇的饮食，五例接受了依折麦布治疗。四例有可用随访数据的患者在4-12个月的随访期间显示血红蛋白、血小板计数和脾脏大小改善。一例失访，一例随访不足无法评估结局。

结论：因此，对于不明原因的血细胞减少、口形红细胞增多、巨血小板减少和脾肿大的患者，应考虑谷固醇血症。早期识别和基因确认该病可及时进行饮食调整和依折麦布治疗，从而改善血液学结局并避免不必要的检查。

title: FLNC-Related Cardiomyopathies in an Admixed Population: Expanding the Genotype-Phenotype Spectrum and Clinical Correlates.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Pathogenic and likely pathogenic variants in filamin C (FLNC) cause a broad spectrum of cardiomyopathies. However, available genotype-phenotype data are derived predominantly from European and North American populations, with limited representation of admixed populations.

METHODS: We characterized carriers of pathogenic/likely pathogenic FLNC variants identified among 2654 unrelated probands undergoing exome sequencing for suspected inherited cardiomyopathy and their relatives identified through cascade screening. Clinical, electrocardiographic, imaging, genetic, and longitudinal data were analyzed according to cardiomyopathy phenotype and variant class. Genetic ancestry was evaluated. Associations with arrhythmic, heart failure, and composite outcomes were examined in exploratory analyses.

RESULTS: The cohort included 97 carriers (58 probands, 39 relatives), of whom 72 had cardiomyopathy and 25 were phenotype-negative at evaluation. Truncating variants predominated among patients with arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy and dilated cardiomyopathy, whereas missense variants were concentrated among those with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy and restrictive cardiomyopathy. Arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy and dilated cardiomyopathy were characterized by a greater burden of ventricular arrhythmias, low QRS voltage, systolic dysfunction, and myocardial fibrosis, whereas hypertrophic cardiomyopathy and restrictive cardiomyopathy showed greater wall thickness and more atrial arrhythmias. Twelve pathogenic/likely pathogenic variants absent from gnomAD and ClinVar were identified. Ancestry analysis confirmed heterogeneous genetic backgrounds but detected no ancestry-related differences in variant class or phenotype. In exploratory outcome analyses, nonsustained ventricular tachycardia, low QRS voltage, and late gadolinium enhancement were associated with outcomes.

CONCLUSIONS: This deeply phenotyped Brazilian cohort expands the FLNC variant spectrum and supports broad genotype-phenotype associations across an admixed population. Exploratory findings suggest that markers of ventricular arrhythmia and myocardial fibrosis may complement left ventricular ejection fraction in future risk-stratification strategies, although validation in larger, independent cohorts is required.

AI.tldr: 在巴西混合人群中，FLNC致病/可能致病变异携带者表现为表型谱广泛，截短变异多见于致心律失常性心肌病和扩张型心肌病，错义变异集中于肥厚型心肌病和限制型心肌病，非持续性室速、低QRS电压和晚期钆增强与不良结局相关。
AI.motivation: FLNC致病/可能致病变异可导致多种心肌病，但现有基因型-表型数据主要来自欧洲和北美人群，混合人群代表性不足，临床风险分层证据有限。
AI.method: 对2654例因疑似遗传性心肌病接受外显子测序的无亲缘关系先证者及其级联筛查亲属进行FLNC致病/可能致病变异携带者鉴定，共纳入97例携带者（58例先证者，39例亲属），分析临床、心电图、影像、遗传及纵向数据，按心肌病表型和变异类型分组，评估遗传祖先，探索性分析心律失常、心力衰竭及复合终点。
AI.result: 97例携带者中72例有心肌病表型，25例评估时表型阴性；截短变异在致心律失常性心肌病和扩张型心肌病中占优势，错义变异集中于肥厚型心肌病和限制型心肌病；致心律失常性心肌病和扩张型心肌病室性心律失常、低QRS电压、收缩功能障碍和心肌纤维化负担更重，肥厚型心肌病和限制型心肌病壁厚度更大、房性心律失常更多；发现12个gnomAD和ClinVar未收录的致病/可能致病变异；祖先分析显示遗传背景异质但变异类型或表型无祖先相关差异；探索性结局分析中非持续性室速、低QRS电压和晚期钆增强与结局相关（摘要未报告具体效应量及95%CI/P值）。
AI.conclusion: 该深度表型化的巴西队列扩展了FLNC变异谱，支持混合人群中广泛的基因型-表型关联；探索性提示室性心律失常和心肌纤维化标志物可能在未来风险分层中补充左心室射血分数，但需更大独立队列验证。

summary_zh:
背景：细丝蛋白C（FLNC）的致病性和可能致病性变异导致广泛的心肌病谱系。然而，现有的基因型-表型数据主要来自欧洲和北美人群，混合人群的代表性有限。

方法：我们对2654例因疑似遗传性心肌病接受外显子组测序的无亲缘关系先证者及其通过级联筛查发现的亲属中，鉴定出的FLNC致病性/可能致病性变异携带者进行了特征分析。根据心肌病表型和变异类型分析了临床、心电图、影像学、遗传学和纵向数据。评估了遗传祖先。在探索性分析中检查了与心律失常、心力衰竭和复合结局的关联。

结果：队列包括97例携带者（58例先证者，39例亲属），其中72例患有心肌病，25例在评估时表型阴性。截短变异在致心律失常性心肌病和扩张型心肌病患者中占主导，而错义变异集中在肥厚型心肌病和限制型心肌病患者中。致心律失常性心肌病和扩张型心肌病的特征是室性心律失常负荷更大、QRS电压低、收缩功能障碍和心肌纤维化，而肥厚型心肌病和限制型心肌病则表现为室壁厚度更大和更多房性心律失常。鉴定出12个gnomAD和ClinVar中不存在的致病性/可能致病性变异。祖先分析证实了遗传背景的异质性，但未检测到变异类型或表型与祖先相关的差异。在探索性结局分析中，非持续性室性心动过速、低QRS电压和晚期钆增强与结局相关。

结论：这个深度表型化的巴西队列扩展了FLNC变异谱，并支持混合人群中广泛的基因型-表型关联。探索性发现提示，室性心律失常和心肌纤维化的标志物可能在未来风险分层策略中补充左心室射血分数，但需要在更大、独立的队列中进行验证。

title: Endocardial thickening in dilated cardiomyopathy associated with <i>FHL2</i> variant: a case report
summary: Background FHL2 is critical for cardiac development, and its variants are associated with early-onset severe dilated cardiomyopathy (DCM), though such reports remain rare.Case presentation The patient was a 30-day-old male infant admitted with a 3-day history of cough, a 2-day history of poor feeding, and lethargy lasting half a day. Echocardiography revealed left ventricular enlargement, with a minimum left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) of only 13%, and endocardial thickening. Genetic testing identified a heterozygous missense variant c.391C>T (p.Arg131Cys) in FHL2. This variant was confirmed to be de novo. According to the American College of Medical Genetics and Genomics (ACMG) guidelines, it was classified as likely pathogenic, suggestive of DCM. After heart failure management and other symptomatic treatments, the patient's clinical symptoms improved. However, LVEF remained low at 15.5% during the 6-month follow-up.Conclusion The heterozygous missense variant c.391C>T (p.Arg131Cys) in FHL2 is associated with DCM in this patient, and the endocardial thickening may represent a secondary change. However, we acknowledge that without pathological examination of the explanted heart or endomyocardial biopsy, the possibility of primary endocardial fibroelastosis (EFE) cannot be completely excluded. This study emphasizes the clinical importance of distinguishing true primary EFE from secondary EFE-like endocardial changes associated with severe DCM, and genetic testing is valuable for their differential diagnosis.

AI.tldr: 一例30天男婴携带FHL2新发错义变异c.391C>T（p.Arg131Cys），表现为左室扩大、LVEF低至13%及心内膜增厚，随访6个月LVEF仍仅15.5%，提示该变异与早发重症DCM相关。
AI.motivation: FHL2对心脏发育至关重要，其变异与早发重症DCM相关，但此类报道罕见；临床需鉴别原发性心内膜弹力纤维增生症（EFE）与重症DCM继发的心内膜增厚样改变，基因检测可能有助于鉴别。
AI.method: 个案报道。研究对象为30天男婴，因咳嗽3天、喂养差2天、嗜睡半天入院。行超声心动图评估心脏结构与功能，基因检测筛查FHL2变异，并对变异进行家系验证及ACMG分级。主要观察心脏结构功能变化及基因变异致病性。
AI.result: 超声心动图显示左心室扩大，最低LVEF仅13%，伴心内膜增厚。基因检测发现FHL2杂合错义变异c.391C>T（p.Arg131Cys），家系验证证实为新发变异，按ACMG指南分类为可能致病，提示DCM。经心衰管理等对症治疗后临床症状改善，但6个月随访时LVEF仍低至15.5%。摘要未报告其他统计数值。
AI.conclusion: 该FHL2杂合错义变异c.391C>T（p.Arg131Cys）与患者DCM相关，心内膜增厚可能为继发性改变；但未行移植心脏病理检查或心内膜心肌活检，不能完全排除原发性EFE。研究强调鉴别真性原发性EFE与重症DCM继发EFE样心内膜改变的重要性，基因检测对鉴别诊断有价值。

summary_zh: 背景：FHL2 对心脏发育至关重要，其变异与早发性严重扩张型心肌病（DCM）相关，尽管此类报道仍然罕见。病例介绍：患者为一名 30 天大的男婴，因咳嗽 3 天、喂养不良 2 天和嗜睡半天入院。超声心动图显示左心室扩大，最低左心室射血分数（LVEF）仅为 13%，并伴有心内膜增厚。基因检测发现 FHL2 基因杂合错义变异 c.391C>T（p.Arg131Cys）。该变异被证实为新发变异。根据美国医学遗传学与基因组学学会（ACMG）指南，该变异被分类为可能致病，提示 DCM。经过心力衰竭管理和其他对症治疗后，患者临床症状改善。然而，在 6 个月随访期间，LVEF 仍低至 15.5%。结论：FHL2 基因杂合错义变异 c.391C>T（p.Arg131Cys）与该患者的 DCM 相关，心内膜增厚可能代表继发性改变。然而，我们承认，在没有对摘除心脏进行病理检查或心内膜心肌活检的情况下，不能完全排除原发性心内膜弹力纤维增生症（EFE）的可能性。本研究强调了区分真正原发性 EFE 与严重 DCM 相关的继发性 EFE 样心内膜改变的临床重要性，基因检测对其鉴别诊断具有价值。

title: Editorial: Cardiovascular Imaging Case Reports 2025: Emphasizing Uncommon Clinical Scenarios
summary: Cardiology and vascular medicine continue to rapidly evolve in terms of percutaneous therapeutic capabilities for our patients, yet accurate diagnosis and effective management of complex cardiovascular diseases remain major clinical challenges that require increasingly advanced diagnostic tools. Multimodality imaging is central to this process, offering essential insights into cardiac anatomy, perfusion, viability, function, and tissue characterization. Technological advances in recent decades have expanded clinicians' ability to assess complex clinical problems. Available modalities range from echocardiography, the established first-line imaging technique, to cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) and computed tomography (CT), each with distinct strengths and limitations. Therefore, a multimodality imaging approach that combines their complementary advantages is often needed in clinical practice. The present collection presents real-world cases in which cardiovascular imaging, used alone or in combination, helped resolve diagnostic uncertainty, characterize pathology precisely, and guide optimal treatment strategies. Non-invasive imaging: From serial echocardiography to the integrative approach of multimodality imaging. Echocardiography was central to assessing cardiac dimensions and function in a 79-year-old woman with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (10.3389/fcvm.2026.1762249). The patient presented with signs of congestive heart failure, and echocardiography revealed new-onset tricuspid annular dilatation with torrential tricuspid regurgitation. These findings guided management and led to deferral of minimally invasive tricuspid valve clipping. After successful electrical cardioversion, reverse right atrial remodeling occurred, with resolution of atrial enlargement and tricuspid regurgitation. Clinical symptoms also improved within a few weeks. To maintain sinus rhythm, the patient underwent cryoablation, and her subsequent clinical course was uneventful.The central role of non-invasive cardiovascular imaging for the diagnosis of microvascular dysfunction in a patient with cardiac amyloidosis is highlighted by Yuqian Dai et al in (10.3389/fcvm.2026.1710211). Cardiac amyloidosis (CA) is a rare but increasingly recognized cause of myocardial storage disease causing heart failure. [1][2][3] In a patient with lightchain (AL) cardiac amyloidosis and exertional angina, contrast adenosine stress echocardiography with Doppler-derived coronary flow velocity reserve (CFVR) showed impaired myocardial perfusion. These findings were consistent with CMR and laboratory results, confirming myocardial amyloid deposition. This case supports the use of contrast adenosine stress echocardiography as a practical adjunct to advanced imaging for evaluating microvascular dysfunction.The case presented by Yuting Yi et al (10.3389/fcvm.2026.1774080) underscores the central role of multimodality cardiovascular imaging in modern cardiology. In a 54-year-old woman with exertional dyspnea and signs of heart failure, multimodality imaging demonstrated apical hypertrophy with cavity obliteration, endocardial fibrosis, and calcification. 18 F-FDG PET-CT showed intense apical uptake, initially raising concern for malignancy. However, CMR with late gadolinium enhancement (LGE) supported a diagnosis of hypertrophic cardiomyopathy. Endomyocardial biopsy and genetic testing further identified a pathogenic MYH7 variant, consistent with this diagnosis. The importance of CMR and genetic testing in hypertrophic cardiomyopathy has also been highlighted in recent large multicenter studies. 4 Another case underscoring the role of multimodality imaging with cardiac masses has been presented by Juan Wang et al (10.3389/fcvm.2025.1685844). Pericardial involvement with myxoid liposarcoma is exceptionally rare and usually indicates metastatic disease. In the present case multimodal imaging (CT, ultrasound, CMR) revealed a pericardial mass compatible with metastatic liposarcoma. The diagnosis was confirmed by histopathology and molecular testing. The role of CMR for the diagnostic classification and risk stratification of patients with cardiac masses has been recently demonstrated in single-and multi-center studies. 5,6 In a related case with cardiac malignancy (10.3389/fcvm.2025.1688224), Konuş presents a 47-year-old female suffering from heart failure induced by a giant primary pericardial schwannoma. Although multimodality imaging established the presence and extension of the cardiac tumor, the definitive preoperative histological diagnosis was achieved using a method rarely employed in cardiovascular diseases, namely endoscopic ultrasoundguided fine needle aspiration (EUS-FNA). This report supports the use of this method as an alternative to open surgical biopsy for lesions situated favorably relative to the esophageal tract.The versatility of modern CMR allows the assessment of myocardial function, perfusion, viability and if required myocardial metabolism and tissue characterization and strain within a single examination and without radiation exposure for the patients. 7,8 However, extrasystoles may pose a significant limitation for image quality with CMR. This is highlighted in (10.3389/fcvm.2025.1596440), where Röwer et al report on the ability of real-time CMR to offer high image quality during free breathing and, in combination with an ECG provide a unique opportunity to analyze cardiac hemodynamics, which was not feasible using conventional CMR sequences. The utility of multimodality imaging in procedural guidance. In the report by Mandic et al. (10.3389/fcvm.2025.1637475), the authors present a 65-year-old female with severe hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy diagnosed by multimodality imaging and referred for alcohol septal ablation. However, the presence of a rare congenital coronary artery anomaly with a single right coronary artery led to procedural failure, thus prompting the operators to use an alternative approach with micro-coil embolization. CT angiography visualized the complex anatomy and the successful closure of the septal branch which was accompanied by substantial reduction of the gradient and improvement in the clinical status. This case supports the use of micro-coil embolization as a viable, localized alternative when hostile anatomy precludes standard alcohol delivery.Also supporting the value of an integrative multimodality imaging approach for interventional guidance, Karanasos et al. (10.3389/fcvm.2026.1796191) describe a rare case of an iatrogenic left main (LM) to left ventricle coronarocameral fistula discovered a decade after surgical aortic valve replacement. The integration of coronary angiography, three-dimensional transesophageal echocardiography and intravascular ultrasound (IVUS) was used to differentiate a true fistulous tract from paravalvular regurgitation. Percutaneous coronary intervention of the severely calcified LM disease was prioritized, thereby securing epicardial flow and deferring the high-risk closure of the fistula itself. Importantly, the procedure was guided by IVUS, consistent with the pivotal role of intravascular imaging in this lesion subset. 9 Li et al. ( 10.3389/fcvm.2025.1660781) describe a case where angiographic guidance was preferred over traditional surgical drainage for the management of a challenging loculated, eccentric purulent pericarditis in a 60-year-old male. Using a coronary guidewire and a microcatheter, the operators safely accessed the pericardial space for drainage and alteplase administration. This off-label use of traditional coronary intervention tools provided an alternative for minimizing surgical risk in a highly comorbid patient. However, this approach should be cautiously applied as there is a risk of iatrogenic myocardial injury when utilizing off-label coronary wires in inflamed pericardial spaces. Diagnostic pitfalls and complications of imaging procedures. Several cases in this collection serve to highlight several limitations of cardiovascular imaging and a need for careful interpretation always considering the clinical presentation. Chen et al. (10.3389/fcvm.2025.1670164) present two cases with localized right sinus of Valsalva dissection masquerading clinically and electrocardiographically as inferior STEMI due to extrinsic right coronary artery compression. In these cases, high clinical suspicion prompted the authors to use additional imaging, i.e. aortic root angiography and CT angiography in one case and IVUS in the other to establish the diagnosis of localized right sinus of Valsalva dissection. Similarly, Jia et al. ( 10.3389/fcvm.2026.1769867) report on two patients with localized aortic root dissection that initially evaded detection. Both patients had atypical symptoms and severe aortic regurgitation, and despite a multimodality imaging approach including transthoracic and transesophageal echocardiography and CT angiography, were misclassified as congenital supravalvular aortic membranes, with the correct diagnosis of localized aortic root dissection being established in the operating room and supported by retrospective analysis of the CT angiography images. The manuscript tells a cautionary tale regarding the diagnostic pitfalls inherent in evaluating severe aortic regurgitation of unclear etiology, particularly when patients lack classical symptoms. Furthermore, it is important to acknowledge that in such cases transesophageal echocardiography has a complementary role for guidance in the operating room (10.3389/fcvm.2025.1660722). 10 Ying Cai et al (10.3389/fcvm.2026.1774967) highlight the potential risks and complications of invasive diagnostic procedures. A 62-year-old woman with arterial hypertension underwent diagnostic coronary angiography using 40 mL of the iso-osmolar contrast medium iodixanol. Ten minutes later, she developed rapidly progressive bilateral visual loss that progressed to complete blindness. Emergent cranial CT and MRI showed no evidence of acute infarction or hemorrhage, and contrast-induced transient cortical blindness was suspected. With supportive treatment, her vision returned to normal within one week. This case supports the initial use of non-invasive imaging, as recommended by current position statements and guidelines. Overall, this case report collection highlights the growing role of advances in noninvasive cardiac imaging for diagnostic classification and risk stratification in patients with cardiac diseases. Integrating these modalities into routine clinical practice, particularly in challenging cases such as those presented here, can support timely and precise diagnosis, improve patient management, and ultimately improve patient management and outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本社论汇编多例心血管影像病例，展示多模态影像在复杂心血管病诊断、鉴别及介入引导中的关键作用，并警示诊断陷阱与操作并发症。
AI.motivation: 心血管疾病经皮治疗能力快速发展，但复杂病例的准确诊断与有效管理仍是临床难题，需依赖日益先进的诊断工具；多模态影像可提供心脏解剖、灌注、存活、功能及组织特征等关键信息，但临床对罕见场景的识别及影像局限性认识不足。
AI.method: 本文为社论，汇编2025年心血管影像病例报告，涵盖超声心动图、心脏磁共振（CMR）、CT、PET-CT、三维经食管超声、血管内超声（IVUS）等多模态影像，涉及房颤、心脏淀粉样变、肥厚型心肌病、心脏肿瘤、冠脉异常、主动脉窦局部夹层等病例，描述影像在诊断与介入引导中的作用；摘要未报告系统样本量、终点定义或统计方法。
AI.result: 系列病例显示：79岁阵发性房颤患者经超声发现三尖瓣环扩张并重度反流，电复律后右房重构逆转、反流消失，后行冷冻消融；AL型心脏淀粉样变患者腺苷负荷超声示冠脉血流速度储备受损，与CMR及实验室结果一致；54岁女性肥厚型心肌病经CMR晚期钆增强及基因检测（MYH7变异）确诊；心包黏液样脂肪肉瘤、心包施万细胞瘤经多模态影像及EUS-FNA确诊；实时CMR在自由呼吸下提供高质量图像分析血流动力学；酒精室间隔消融因单一右冠状动脉异常失败，改用微线圈栓塞成功；医源性左主干-左室瘘经冠脉造影、三维TEE及IVUS鉴别并优先处理左主干钙化病变；局部主动脉窦夹层模拟下壁STEMI，经主动脉根部造影、CT或IVUS确诊；碘克沙醇冠脉造影后短暂皮质盲一周内恢复。摘要未报告效应量、95%CI或P值。
AI.conclusion: 多模态影像可提高复杂心血管病的诊断准确性、指导治疗策略并改善管理，但需警惕影像误判（如局部主动脉窦夹层被误认为先天畸形）及侵入性操作并发症（如对比剂诱导短暂皮质盲）；临床应结合表现审慎解读，优先无创影像，介入引导中IVUS等腔内影像价值明确；本文为病例汇编，结论外推受限。

summary_zh: 心脏病学和血管医学在经皮治疗能力方面继续快速发展，然而复杂心血管疾病的准确诊断和有效管理仍然是主要的临床挑战，需要越来越先进的诊断工具。多模态成像在这一过程中处于核心地位，为心脏解剖、灌注、存活、功能和组织表征提供了重要的见解。近几十年的技术进步扩展了临床医生评估复杂临床问题的能力。可用的模态范围从超声心动图这一既定的一线成像技术，到心脏磁共振（CMR）和计算机断层扫描（CT），每种都有其独特的优势和局限性。因此，临床实践中通常需要采用结合其互补优势的多模态成像方法。本合集呈现了真实世界的病例，中心血管成像单独或联合使用，帮助解决了诊断不确定性，精确表征了病理，并指导了最佳治疗策略。无创成像：从系列超声心动图到多模态成像的整合方法。超声心动图在评估一位79岁女性阵发性心房颤动患者的心脏尺寸和功能中处于核心地位（10.3389/fcvm.2026.1762249）。该患者表现出充血性心力衰竭的体征，超声心动图显示新发的三尖瓣环扩张伴大量三尖瓣反流。这些发现指导了管理，并导致推迟了微创三尖瓣夹合术。成功电复律后，发生了右心房逆重构，心房增大和三尖瓣反流消退。临床症状也在几周内改善。为维持窦性心律，患者接受了冷冻消融，其后续临床过程平稳。Yuqian Dai等人在（10.3389/fcvm.2026.1710211）中强调了无创心血管成像在诊断心脏淀粉样变性患者微血管功能障碍中的核心作用。心脏淀粉样变性（CA）是一种罕见但日益被认识的心肌贮积病病因，导致心力衰竭。[1][2][3] 在一名轻链（AL）心脏淀粉样变性并劳力性心绞痛的患者中，对比剂腺苷负荷超声心动图结合多普勒衍生的冠状动脉血流速度储备（CFVR）显示心肌灌注受损。这些发现与CMR和实验室结果一致，证实了心肌淀粉样物质沉积。该病例支持使用对比剂腺苷负荷超声心动图作为高级成像的实用辅助手段来评估微血管功能障碍。Yuting Yi等人（10.3389/fcvm.2026.1774080）呈现的病例强调了多模态心血管成像在现代心脏病学中的核心作用。在一名54岁女性劳力性呼吸困难和心力衰竭体征的患者中，多模态成像显示心尖肥厚伴心腔闭塞、心内膜纤维化和钙化。18 F-FDG PET-CT显示心尖部强烈摄取，最初引起对恶性肿瘤的担忧。然而，CMR伴晚期钆增强（LGE）支持肥厚型心肌病的诊断。心内膜心肌活检和基因检测进一步确定了致病性MYH7变异，与该诊断一致。CMR和基因检测在肥厚型心肌病中的重要性也在最近的大型多中心研究中被强调。4 另一个强调多模态成像在心脏肿块中作用的病例由Juan Wang等人呈现（10.3389/fcvm.2025.1685844）。心包受累的黏液样脂肪肉瘤极为罕见，通常提示转移性疾病。在本病例中，多模态成像（CT、超声、CMR）显示心包肿块符合转移性脂肪肉瘤。诊断经组织病理学和分子检测证实。CMR在心脏肿块患者诊断分类和风险分层中的作用最近已在单中心和多中心研究中得到证明。5,6 在一个相关的心脏恶性肿瘤病例中（10.3389/fcvm.2025.1688224），Konuş呈现了一名47岁女性，患有由巨大原发性心包神经鞘瘤引起的心力衰竭。尽管多模态成像确定了心脏肿瘤的存在和范围，但术前明确的组织学诊断是通过一种在心血管疾病中很少使用的方法实现的，即超声内镜引导下细针穿刺（EUS-FNA）。本报告支持使用该方法作为开放手术活检的替代方案，用于相对于食管 tract 位置有利的病变。现代CMR的多功能性允许在一次检查中评估心肌功能、灌注、存活，以及如果需要的话心肌代谢和组织表征和应变，且患者无需暴露于辐射。7,8 然而，期前收缩可能对CMR的图像质量构成显著限制。这在（10.3389/fcvm.2025.1596440）中被强调，其中Röwer等人报告了实时CMR在自由呼吸期间提供高图像质量的能力，并与ECG结合提供了分析心脏血流动力学的独特机会，这是传统CMR序列无法实现的。多模态成像在手术引导中的效用。在Mandic等人的报告中（10.3389/fcvm.2025.1637475），作者呈现了一名65岁女性，通过多模态成像诊断为严重肥厚型梗阻性心肌病，并转诊接受酒精室间隔消融。然而，存在一种罕见的先天性冠状动脉异常，即单一右冠状动脉，导致手术失败，从而促使操作者使用微弹簧圈栓塞的替代方法。CT血管造影可视化了复杂解剖结构，并成功闭合了室间隔支，伴随梯度显著降低和临床状态改善。该病例支持使用微弹簧圈栓塞作为一种可行的、局部的替代方案，当不利解剖结构妨碍标准酒精输送时。同样支持整合多模态成像方法在介入引导中的价值，Karanasos等人（10.3389/fcvm.2026.1796191）描述了一例罕见的医源性左主干（LM）至左心室冠状动脉-心腔瘘，在外科主动脉瓣置换术后十年被发现。冠状动脉造影、三维经食管超声心动图和血管内超声（IVUS）的整合用于区分真性瘘管和瓣周反流。优先对严重钙化的LM病变进行经皮冠状动脉介入治疗，从而确保了心外膜血流并推迟了瘘管本身的高风险闭合。重要的是，手术由IVUS引导，与血管内成像在该病变亚组中的关键作用一致。9 Li等人（10.3389/fcvm.2025.1660781）描述了一例60岁男性，对于具有挑战性的局限性、偏心性化脓性心包炎，血管造影引导优于传统外科引流。使用冠状动脉导丝和微导管，操作者安全进入心包腔进行引流和给予阿替普酶。这种传统冠状动脉介入工具的标签外使用为最小化高合并症患者的手术风险提供了替代方案。然而，这种方法应谨慎应用，因为在炎症心包腔中使用标签外冠状动脉导丝存在医源性心肌损伤的风险。成像程序的诊断陷阱和并发症。本合集中的几个病例突出了心血管成像的一些局限性，以及始终考虑临床表现进行仔细解释的必要性。Chen等人（10.3389/fcvm.2025.1670164）呈现了两例局限性右Valsalva窦夹层，由于外源性右冠状动脉压迫，在临床和心电图上伪装为下壁STEMI。在这些病例中，高度临床怀疑促使作者使用额外的成像，即一例使用主动脉根部造影和CT血管造影，另一例使用IVUS，以建立局限性右Valsalva窦夹层的诊断。类似地，Jia等人（10.3389/fcvm.2026.1769867）报告了两名局限性主动脉根部夹层患者，最初未被发现。两名患者均有非典型症状和严重主动脉反流，尽管采用了包括经胸和经食管超声心动图和CT血管造影的多模态成像方法，仍被误分类为先天性主动脉瓣上隔膜，正确的局限性主动脉根部夹层诊断在手术室中建立，并得到CT血管造影图像回顾性分析的支持。该手稿讲述了关于评估病因不明的严重主动脉反流时固有诊断陷阱的警示故事，特别是当患者缺乏典型症状时。此外，重要的是要承认，在这种情况下，经食管超声心动图在手术室引导中具有补充作用（10.3389/fcvm.2025.1660722）。10 Ying Cai等人（10.3389/fcvm.2026.1774967）强调了侵入性诊断程序的潜在风险和并发症。一名62岁女性动脉高血压患者使用40 mL等渗对比剂碘克沙醇进行了诊断性冠状动脉造影。十分钟后，她出现快速进展的双侧视力丧失，进展为完全失明。紧急头颅CT和MRI显示无急性梗死或出血证据，怀疑对比剂诱导的短暂性皮质盲。经过支持治疗，她的视力在一周内恢复正常。该病例支持初始使用无创成像，如当前立场声明和指南所推荐。总体而言，本病例报告合集突出了无创心脏成像进展在心脏疾病患者诊断分类和风险分层中日益增长的作用。将这些模态整合到常规临床实践中，特别是在像这里呈现的挑战性病例中，可以支持及时和精确的诊断，改善患者管理，并最终改善患者管理和结果。

title: Clinical and Genetic Characteristics of Hereditary Arrhythmias and Cardiomyopathies in the Middle East
summary: Inherited arrhythmias and cardiomyopathies are leading causes of sudden cardiac death in young individuals. Although global registries and genetic databases have advanced diagnosis and prevention globally, data from the Middle East (ME) remain limited and fragmented. This review synthesizes clinical and genetic evidence on long QT syndrome, catecholaminergic polymorphic ventricular tachycardia, Brugada syndrome, arrhythmogenic right ventricular cardiomyopathy, hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, and dilated cardiomyopathy across the ME. A defining feature of ME cohorts is the high prevalence of consanguinity, which shapes a distinctive genetic and clinical landscape across these conditions. Autosomal recessive inheritance is consistently enriched, producing homozygous genotypes, which frequently manifest as earlier onset and more aggressive clinical phenotypes compared with those in non-ME populations. Population-specific founder variants have been identified across multiple conditions, whereas consanguineous pedigrees have contributed to the discovery of novel disease genes and recessive mechanisms that expand the global genetic landscape of inherited cardiovascular disease. However, a disproportionately high burden of variants of uncertain significance persists across conditions, driven largely by underrepresentation of ME populations in global genomic reference databases. Emerging large-scale genome initiatives such as the Qatar Biobank, the Egyptian Genome Project, and the Greater Middle East Variome offer a viable path toward ancestry-specific variant interpretation. Strengthening regional registries, genomic resources, and family-based screening programs will be essential to improving risk stratification and prevention of sudden cardiac death in the ME.
journal: Mayo Clin Proc Innov Qual Outcomes

AI.tldr: 中东地区遗传性心律失常与心肌病以近亲婚配导致常染色体隐性遗传富集为特征，纯合基因型使发病更早、表型更重，但意义不明变异负担高。
AI.motivation: 遗传性心律失常与心肌病是年轻人心脏性猝死的主要原因，全球注册登记与基因数据库已推动诊治，但中东地区数据有限且碎片化，亟需系统梳理该人群的临床与遗传特征以指导风险分层与预防。
AI.method: 本文为综述，汇总中东地区关于长QT综合征、儿茶酚胺敏感性多形性室性心动过速、Brugada综合征、致心律失常性右心室心肌病、肥厚型心肌病及扩张型心肌病的临床与遗传学证据；未纳入原始研究，无样本量、干预措施及终点定义，摘要未报告具体统计方法与效应量。
AI.result: 中东队列的核心特征是近亲婚配率高，常染色体隐性遗传显著富集并产生纯合基因型，临床表现较非中东人群更早发、更具侵袭性；多种疾病已鉴定出人群特异性奠基者变异，近亲家系还促成了新致病基因与隐性机制的发现；但意义不明变异负担异常高，主要因中东人群在全球基因组参考数据库中代表性不足。摘要未报告具体患病率、变异频率或效应量。
AI.conclusion: 中东遗传性心血管病的遗传结构独特，需依托卡塔尔生物样本库、埃及基因组计划及大中东变异组等计划实现祖先特异性变异解读，并加强区域注册登记、基因组资源与家系筛查以改善风险分层和猝死预防；本文为综述，结论基于现有文献，缺乏原始数据验证。

summary_zh: 遗传性心律失常和心肌病是年轻人心脏性猝死的主要原因。尽管全球注册登记和遗传数据库已在全球范围内推进了诊断和预防，但来自中东地区（ME）的数据仍然有限且零散。本综述综合了中东地区关于长QT综合征、儿茶酚胺敏感性多形性室性心动过速、Brugada综合征、致心律失常性右心室心肌病、肥厚型心肌病和扩张型心肌病的临床和遗传学证据。中东队列的一个决定性特征是近亲结婚的高患病率，这塑造了这些疾病独特的遗传和临床格局。常染色体隐性遗传始终富集，产生纯合基因型，与非中东人群相比，这些基因型频繁表现为更早发病和更具侵袭性的临床表型。在多种疾病中已鉴定出人群特异性奠基者变异，而近亲家系则有助于发现新的疾病基因和隐性机制，从而扩展了遗传性心血管疾病的全球遗传格局。然而，在各疾病中，意义不明变异的高负担持续存在，这主要由于中东人群在全球基因组参考数据库中代表性不足所致。新兴的大规模基因组计划，如卡塔尔生物样本库、埃及基因组计划和大中东变异组计划，为祖先特异性变异解读提供了可行路径。加强区域注册登记、基因组资源和基于家庭的筛查项目，对于改善中东地区心脏性猝死的风险分层和预防至关重要。

title: NS1643 enhances the activity of T1019PfsX38 and Q1070X hERG channels associated with long QT syndrome type 2.
summary: Type 2 long QT syndrome (LQT2) increases the risk of cardiac arrest and sudden death due to reduced rapid delayed rectifier potassium currents (IKr) in the heart. Caused by loss-of-function genetic variants in the hERG K+ channel, LQT2 might benefit from variant-targeted therapy approaches. T1019PfsX38 and Q1070X are LQT2-causing variants reported in Oman and Saudi Arabia. Although nonsense-mediated mRNA decay (NMD) has been proposed to contribute to reduced expression of these truncating variants, it remains unclear whether residual mutant hERG channel function can be pharmacologically enhanced. We used the patch-clamp technique and examined the effects of the hERG potentiator NS1643 on wild-type-, T1019PfsX38- and Q1070X-hERG channels expressed in HEK293 cells. We started by assessing the response of these variants under the influence of a ventricular action potential clamp protocol, then used additional protocols to elucidate the drug's mechanism of action. NS1643 [10 µM] enhanced the repolarization currents in wild-type-, T1019PfsX38- and Q1070X-expressing cells. Its effect was associated with accelerated activation rates and a negative shift in the voltage dependence of activation. In addition, NS1643 suppressed fast deactivation transitions. We conclude that the functions of T1019PfsX38- and Q1070X-hERG channels can be augmented by hERG potentiators if NMD is incomplete, which may facilitate the development of a mechanism-based rescue approach.

AI.tldr: 在HEK293细胞中，hERG增强剂NS1643（10 µM）可增强LQT2相关截短变异T1019PfsX38与Q1070X通道的复极电流，为变异靶向药物救援提供依据。
AI.motivation: 2型长QT综合征（LQT2）由hERG钾通道功能缺失变异导致快速延迟整流钾电流（IKr）减少，增加心脏骤停与猝死风险。T1019PfsX38与Q1070X是阿曼和沙特阿拉伯报道的LQT2致病截短变异；尽管无义介导的mRNA降解（NMD）可能降低其表达，但残存突变通道功能能否被药物增强尚不清楚，既往缺乏变异靶向治疗证据。
AI.method: 基础电生理研究。在HEK293细胞中异源表达野生型、T1019PfsX38及Q1070X hERG通道，采用膜片钳技术，先以心室动作电位钳制方案评估电流反应，再用其他电压方案解析药物机制；干预为hERG增强剂NS1643（10 µM）。主要终点为复极电流变化，次要终点包括激活速率、激活电压依赖性及快速失活转变。摘要未报告样本量与统计方法。
AI.result: NS1643（10 µM）增强野生型、T1019PfsX38及Q1070X表达细胞的复极电流；其效应伴随激活速率加快和激活电压依赖性负向移位，并抑制快速失活转变。摘要未报告具体电流幅度、95%CI或P值。
AI.conclusion: 若NMD不完全，hERG增强剂可增强T1019PfsX38与Q1070X通道功能，提示基于机制的LQT2变异靶向救援策略可行。本研究为HEK293细胞水平，尚需患者来源细胞或动物模型验证，且未提供临床疗效数据。

summary_zh: 2型长QT综合征（LQT2）因心脏快速延迟整流钾电流（IKr）减少而增加心脏骤停和猝死的风险。LQT2由hERG K+通道功能丧失的遗传变异引起，可能受益于针对变异的靶向治疗方法。T1019PfsX38和Q1070X是在阿曼和沙特阿拉伯报道的导致LQT2的变异。尽管无义介导的mRNA降解（NMD）已被提出可导致这些截短变异表达减少，但残存突变型hERG通道功能是否可通过药理学增强仍不清楚。我们使用膜片钳技术，检测了hERG增强剂NS1643对在HEK293细胞中表达的野生型、T1019PfsX38和Q1070X hERG通道的影响。我们首先评估了这些变异在心室动作电位钳制方案影响下的反应，然后使用其他方案阐明药物的作用机制。NS1643 [10 µM]增强了表达野生型、T1019PfsX38和Q1070X的细胞中的复极电流。其效应与激活速率加快和激活电压依赖性负向移位相关。此外，NS1643抑制了快速失活转换。我们得出结论：如果NMD不完全，T1019PfsX38和Q1070X hERG通道的功能可被hERG增强剂增强，这可能有助于开发基于机制的挽救方法。

title: Cutaneous ultrastructure reveals potential biomarkers of ventricular arrhythmias in inflammatory cardiomyopathy
summary: Inflammatory cardiomyopathy (ICM), resulting from persistent myocardial inflammation, is associated with life-threatening ventricular arrhythmias (VA). Recent studies suggested overlap between ICM-associated VA and desmosomal diseases affecting the intercalated discs (ID), which are critical for electromechanical coupling. Genetic variants in desmosomal genes cause arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathies and genodermatoses, supporting a potential link between desmosomal dysfunction and arrhythmic risk. This single-center pilot study explored cutaneous abnormalities in patients with ICM complicated by VA, focusing on desmosomal alterations in skin tissue. Four patients (mean age 56 ± 6 years, 50% male) with cardiac magnetic resonance- and endomyocardial biopsy-proven ICM, documented VA, and available myocardial and cutaneous tissue were retrospectively evaluated. Two patients carried genetic variants (DSP and FLNC), while two had systemic autoimmune diseases. Transmission electron microscopy revealed consistent ultrastructural abnormalities in cardiac biopsies, including widened intercellular cleft width (ICW), a marker associated with arrhythmic risk. Similar abnormalities were observed in cutaneous biopsies, including small, narrow, or clustered desmosomes and dermal-epidermal junction detachments. Patients with greater cutaneous desmosomal coupling variability exhibited more complex VA, lower left ventricular ejection fraction, and a genetic etiology. These findings suggest that cutaneous desmosomal abnormalities may mirror cardiac changes and represent a potential biomarker for arrhythmic risk stratification.

AI.tldr: 炎症性心肌病合并室性心律失常患者皮肤电镜显示桥粒异常，且与更复杂VA、更低LVEF及遗传病因相关，提示皮肤桥粒或可作心律失常风险分层生物标志物。
AI.motivation: 炎症性心肌病（ICM）持续心肌炎症与危及生命的室性心律失常（VA）相关。近期研究提示ICM相关VA与累及闰盘（ID）的桥粒疾病存在重叠，桥粒基因变异可导致致心律失常性心肌病和遗传性皮肤病，但ICM患者皮肤桥粒改变与心律失常风险的关系尚不清楚。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性先导研究，纳入4例经心脏磁共振和心内膜心肌活检证实的ICM、有VA记录且具备心肌和皮肤组织的患者（平均年龄56±6岁，50%男性）。其中2例携带DSP和FLNC基因变异，2例有系统性自身免疫病。采用透射电镜观察心肌和皮肤活检的超微结构，重点评估桥粒改变，并分析其与VA复杂性、左心室射血分数（LVEF）及病因的关系。
AI.result: 心肌活检电镜显示一致的超微结构异常，包括细胞间隙宽度（ICW）增宽——与心律失常风险相关的标志。皮肤活检也观察到类似异常，包括桥粒小、窄或成簇分布以及真皮-表皮交界处分离。皮肤桥粒偶联变异性更大的患者，其VA更复杂、LVEF更低，且病因为遗传性。摘要未报告具体效应量、95%置信区间或P值。
AI.conclusion: ICM合并VA患者的皮肤桥粒异常可能反映心脏改变，并作为心律失常风险分层的潜在生物标志物。但本研究为小样本先导研究，结论需更大样本验证，目前尚不能常规用于临床决策。

summary_zh: 背景：炎症性心肌病（ICM）由持续的心肌炎症引起，与危及生命的室性心律失常（VA）相关。近期研究提示，ICM相关的VA与影响闰盘（ID）的桥粒疾病存在重叠，闰盘对机电耦合至关重要。桥粒基因的遗传变异可导致致心律失常性心肌病和遗传性皮肤病，支持桥粒功能障碍与心律失常风险之间的潜在联系。本单中心初步研究探讨了合并VA的ICM患者的皮肤异常，重点关注皮肤组织中的桥粒改变。方法：回顾性评估了4例患者（平均年龄56 ± 6岁，50%为男性），这些患者经心脏磁共振和心内膜心肌活检证实为ICM，有记录的VA，并具备可用的心肌和皮肤组织。两名患者携带遗传变异（DSP和FLNC），而两名患有系统性自身免疫性疾病。结果：透射电子显微镜显示心脏活检中一致的超微结构异常，包括细胞间隙宽度（ICW）增宽，这是与心律失常风险相关的标志物。在皮肤活检中也观察到类似的异常，包括桥粒小、窄或成簇，以及真皮-表皮交界处分离。皮肤桥粒耦合变异性较大的患者表现出更复杂的VA、较低的左心室射血分数和遗传病因。结论：这些发现表明，皮肤桥粒异常可能反映心脏改变，并代表心律失常风险分层的潜在生物标志物。

title: Ethical Conflicts in Industry-Sponsored Genetic Testing for Underserved Health Systems
summary: Photo ID 64616115 © Sergunt | Dreamstime.com Abstract Genetic testing is essential for diagnosing and managing many rare diseases. Testing for high-risk alleles can predict disease decades before symptoms arise and treatment may be too late. However, cost, limited specialist availability, and health system capacity make patients’ access to this testing unequal. Industry-sponsored genetic testing (IST), in which commercial entities provide molecular diagnostics to patients free of cost, has been proposed as a means of addressing this diagnostic inequity. Because of ethical concerns, many health systems have been reluctant to adopt IST even when it is available, particularly when sponsors are developing related therapeutics. This article examines the ethical and practical challenges associated with implementing IST in a clinic setting. Using hereditary variant transthyretin amyloidosis (ATTRv) as a case example, we assess when and how IST can expand access without undermining professional integrity, patient trust, or equitable care. We discuss recurrent ethical concerns surrounding IST, including conflicts of interest, data stewardship, fragmentation of medical records, inadequate education, clinician autonomy, and the risk of inappropriate testing in nonspecialist settings. We propose that IST is neither inherently ethical nor unethical, but rather that there are five conditions under which it may be incorporated appropriately into clinical practice. We conclude that adopting IST may offer a pragmatic solution to access issues in rare disease care, but it should not replace services that non-industry-sponsored, well-resourced, multidisciplinary care teams provide under clinical supervision. Sustainable and equitable diagnostic support will require broader structural transformations. Introduction Genetic testing is increasingly able to identify genetic variants that contribute to rare diseases. However, results from these tests can be confusing and challenging for patients to access, which is made more difficult by the well-recognized shortage of genetics specialists across the country.[i] In some regions, patients may be completely unable to receive the diagnostic services they require and deserve, even when testing would otherwise be covered by the health system. Industry-sponsored testing (IST)—sequencing and analysis that a commercial entity, such as a pharmaceutical company, provides without cost to the patient—is widely available and has been proposed as one strategy to address “diagnostic deserts” in underserved health systems.[ii] However, despite the availability of IST and these health systems’ capability to treat affected patients who have been tested, many healthcare providers have not adopted IST even where no public alternative exists. Reasons for this lack of adoption include staffing constraints, legal concerns, scope-of-practice limits, logistical and resource constraints, and ethical questions. Another reason for this lack of adoption may be that providers may attempt to follow institutional mandates by forgoing all gifts from industry. This adherence to policy reflects a legitimate ethical concern, but categorical refusal may limit patients’ access and clinicians’ ability to exercise beneficence in strict pursuit of institutional independence from industry. This leaves patients to self-advocate, pay out of pocket, endure misdiagnosis, or receive no diagnosis at all, potentially leading to worse health outcomes. It can also force clinicians to refer their patients to other health systems, interrupting continuity of care and imposing new barriers. Moreover, patients may choose not to complete a referral due to issues with insurance coverage, logistical requirements, physical burdens of traveling while ill, and diagnostic fatigue, among other reasons.[iii] Systems administrators, genetics specialists, and ethicists struggle to weigh the issues with the potential risks and benefits represented by IST. Very little has been written on the topic,[iv] but some reports suggest IST may increase uptake of clinically indicated testing[v] while other data demonstrate limitations in no-cost testing for improving uptake based on patient population demographics.[vi] Given the paucity of information, we use the case of hereditary variant transthyretin amyloidosis (ATTRv) to explore the ethical concerns of IST partnerships and the conditions under which those concerns may be overcome. Case Example Amyloidosis is a disorder in which amyloid protein accumulates pathologically in the body causing organ dysfunction. This protein accumulation is involved in the pathophysiology of many degenerative disorders.[vii] One form of amyloidosis is caused by transthyretin (TTR) protein, a normal protein predominantly made by the liver that transports thyroid hormone and retinol (vitamin A). ATTR has been associated with heart conditions, such as congestive heart failure, atrial fibrillation, and conduction abnormalities leading to the need for pacemakers. ATTR is also associated with musculoskeletal complaints including bilateral carpal tunnel syndrome, trigger finger, biceps tendon rupture, and joint arthritis, often requiring joint replacement at earlier ages. Neurological signs of ATTR include peripheral neuropathy, gait imbalances, and autonomic nervous system dysfunction. Early recognition of these symptoms as part of a systemic syndrome is critical, as treatment of the underlying amyloid protein deposition is required to manage these sequelae but does not reverse all the damage already done. ATTR can be subdivided into wild type (ATTRwt, formerly called senile ATTR), characterized by age-related protein misfolding, and hereditary variant (ATTRv), characterized by disease-causing genetic variants in the TTR gene. Once amyloidosis has been diagnosed, only genetic testing can distinguish ATTRwt from ATTRv. A correct, specific diagnosis between ATTRwt and ATTRv is critical, as ATTRv may have earlier onset and more systemic signs and symptoms. However, interpreting genetic results for this testing is complicated. Over 130 pathogenic variants within the TTR gene are associated with ATTRv, and each variant manifests differently across populations. Moreover, patients who are homozygous for a pathogenic variant may exhibit more severe symptoms at an earlier age. While treatment and prognosis are often dictated by the amount of cardiac and neurologic involvement, early genetic testing remains important as certain treatments may only be indicated for either ATTRv or ATTRwt. Different genetic variants are also associated with differing degrees of phenotypic penetrance: some primarily cause either cardiomyopathy or neuropathy while other genetic variants have mixed phenotypes. If a pathogenic variant is present, cascade genetic testing is recommended for first-degree family members, as there may be up to a 50 percent chance that they will be afflicted. Finally, genotyping may identify relatives at high risk of disease before they develop life-limiting cardiomyopathy and prevent irreversible disease progression. While expert opinion and guidelines recommend genetic testing for all patients diagnosed with ATTR[viii] regardless of patient demographics or severity of disease involvement, there are several reasons why genetic testing may not be performed. Patients affected by ATTR amyloidosis may be followed by a diverse team of clinicians. Currently, they are typically treated by advanced heart failure cardiologists and neurologists and are seen at tertiary academic centers of excellence, but this access and diagnostic bottleneck is improving. As the diagnostic pathway has been simplified and several FDA-approved treatments have become available, patients with amyloidosis are increasingly seen in community hospitals and placed under the care of nonspecialists. Because ATTR is a systemic condition, many other specialists may be involved in their care, including gastroenterologists, nephrologists, and orthopedists. In addition, genetics specialists may encounter the disease when screening for unrelated conditions and incidentally find an ATTR disease-causing variant. Industry-sponsored genetic test kits are available for use in diagnosing ATTRv. One example is the NavigATTR Sponsored Testing Program offered through PreventionGenetics, a program sponsored by AstraZeneca and Ionis Pharmaceuticals.[ix] Historically, these tests have not been widely recommended because of these programs’ relationship with their industry sponsors and concerns that the genetic information provided would be limited. However, IST kits offer an alternative route for diagnosis when this may not otherwise be available to affected patient populations. These IST kits are convenient to use and require only a cheek swab and postal drop-box. Some existing gaps in care stem from concerns about the ethics of industry partnerships rather than practical barriers to testing. The arguments for and against IST are outlined in Table 1 and discussed in detail below. See Table 1 (available in PDF version only) Health Systems’ Objections to Industry-Sponsored Testing Health systems may worry that integrating IST into ATTR workups involves a conflict of interest, particularly when testing is funded by companies developing ATTR therapeutics. Patients’ and providers’ distrust of industry involvement in medicine remains strong[x] and some administrators may worry that financial gain could motivate the sponsor’s offer. Even the mere appearance of such conflict can undermine the therapeutic relationship between patients and medical organizations.[xi] However, a commercial interest does not necessarily mean the relevant parties' interests are opposed. A sponsor seeking to identify patients who could benefit from a therapy may in fact share the clinician’s interest in diagnosis and the patient’s interest in receiving appropriate treatment. AI.tldr: 本文以ATTRv为例探讨了在资源匮乏的医疗系统中行业赞助基因检测的伦理冲突，提出在满足五个条件时可适当整合，但不能替代多学科团队的标准诊疗。
AI.motivation: 基因检测对罕见病诊断至关重要，但成本高、专科医生短缺和医疗系统能力有限导致检测可及性不平等。行业赞助基因检测（IST）被提议作为解决诊断不平等的手段，但因伦理顾虑，许多医疗系统不愿采用，尤其当赞助商在研发相关疗法时。现有文献极少，需明确IST在何种条件下可扩大检测可及性而不损害职业诚信、患者信任或公平医疗。
AI.method: 本文为伦理分析与案例讨论，非系统研究。以遗传型转甲状腺素蛋白淀粉样变性（ATTRv）为案例，分析IST在临床实施中的伦理与实践挑战，包括利益冲突、数据管理、病历碎片化、教育不足、临床医生自主权及非专科环境下的不当检测风险。基于文献与专家意见，提出IST可被适当纳入临床实践的五个条件。摘要未报告样本量、终点或统计方法。
AI.result: 摘要未报告定量结果。作者提出IST本身并非固有伦理或不伦理，而是在满足五个条件时可适当纳入临床实践。结论指出IST可为罕见病诊疗的可及性问题提供务实解决方案，但不应替代非行业赞助、资源充足的多学科团队在临床监督下提供的服务。
AI.conclusion: IST在特定条件下可作为一种务实的补充手段改善罕见病诊断可及性，但需警惕利益冲突、数据管理与检测适当性等伦理风险。临床实践中应确保IST不替代标准多学科诊疗，且可持续公平的诊断支持仍需更广泛的结构性改革。摘要未报告具体实施条件细节及局限性分析。

title: Clinical characteristics of patients with Fabry disease in the Russian population
summary: Introduction. Fabry disease is an X-linked lysosomal storage disorder with multisystem involvement, the clinical manifestations and severity of which differ significantly between males and females. The diversity of early symptoms and target organ damage often leads to delayed diagnosis, while timely diagnosis is essential for early initiation of specific therapy. Aim: To study the clinical features of Fabry disease in males and females in the Russian population over the period from 2015 to 2026 for early diagnosis of the disease. Material and Methods. A retrospective cohort study with a comparative analysis of clinical manifestations of Fabry disease in adult males and females was conducted. The cohort study, covering the period from 2015 to 2026, included 259 adult patients with Fabry disease confirmed by molecular genetic testing (150 males and 109 females; median age 45.5 years). To assess target organ damage, daily albuminuria, serum creatinine levels, 24-hour Holter ECG monitoring, echocardiography, cardiac and brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) were performed. Clinical manifestations were assessed in the overall cohort and separately in males and females. Results. The majority of patients had typical early manifestations of Fabry disease from childhood or adolescence, including neuropathic pain in the hands and feet (67.6%), angiokeratomas (33.6%), cornea verticillata (58.3%), hypohidrosis (49.4%), and/or gastrointestinal symptoms (19.3%). The target-organ involvement, that is, kidney, heart, and brain disease, was detected in 80.3%, 61.0%, and 48.3% of patients, respectively. Despite the relatively young age of the examined patients, many presented various disease outcomes, such as dailysis-dependent chronic renal failure (20.1%), stroke (18.1%), including recurrent stroke, and/or severe left ventricular hypertrophy (LVH) (21.6%) accompanied by arrhythmias and/or chronic heart failure. Mortality during follow-up was 12.7%. Male patients had a more severe clinical course of Fabry disease and developed adverse outcomes at younger age. Conclusion. Fabry disease should be suspected in adults patients with nephropathy or left ventricular hypertrophy of unknown origin and/or stroke at a young age, particularly when these findings are accompanied by typical early manifestations of the disease.
journal: Сибирский журнал клинической и экспериментальной медицины

AI.tldr: 俄罗斯Fabry病队列中，男性临床病程更重且不良结局发生更早，多数患者儿童期即有典型早期表现，靶器官损害常见。
AI.motivation: Fabry病为X连锁溶酶体贮积病，男女临床表现和严重程度差异显著，早期症状多样易致诊断延迟，而及时诊断对尽早启动特异性治疗至关重要；俄罗斯人群的相关临床特征数据尚缺乏。
AI.method: 回顾性队列研究，纳入2015—2026年经分子遗传学确诊的259例成年Fabry病患者（男150例、女109例，中位年龄45.5岁），比较男女临床表现；通过尿白蛋白、血肌酐、24小时动态心电图、超声心动图、心脏及脑MRI评估靶器官损害，分析全队列及按性别分层的临床特征。
AI.result: 多数患者儿童或青少年期即有典型早期表现：手足神经痛67.6%、血管角皮瘤33.6%、角膜涡状混浊58.3%、少汗49.4%、胃肠道症状19.3%。靶器官受累：肾脏80.3%、心脏61.0%、脑48.3%。不良结局包括透析依赖的慢性肾衰竭20.1%、卒中18.1%（含复发性卒中）、严重左心室肥厚21.6%（伴心律失常和/或慢性心力衰竭）；随访死亡率12.7%。男性临床病程更重，不良结局发生年龄更早。
AI.conclusion: 成人不明原因肾病、左心室肥厚和/或年轻卒中，尤其伴Fabry病典型早期表现者，应怀疑Fabry病。男性患者病情更重、结局更早，提示需早期识别和干预；本研究为回顾性单国队列，摘要未报告具体效应量及置信区间，结论外推需谨慎。

summary_zh: 引言。法布雷病是一种X连锁溶酶体贮积病，累及多系统，其临床表现和严重程度在男性和女性之间存在显著差异。早期症状和靶器官损害的多样性常导致诊断延迟，而及时诊断对于早期启动特异性治疗至关重要。目的：研究2015年至2026年期间俄罗斯人群中男性和女性法布雷病的临床特征，以实现该病的早期诊断。材料与方法。进行了一项回顾性队列研究，对成年男性和女性法布雷病的临床表现进行比较分析。该队列研究覆盖2015年至2026年期间，纳入259例经分子遗传学检测确诊的法布雷病成年患者（150例男性，109例女性；中位年龄45.5岁）。为评估靶器官损害，进行了每日白蛋白尿、血清肌酐水平、24小时动态心电图监测、超声心动图、心脏和脑磁共振成像（MRI）检查。在总体队列中以及分别在男性和女性中评估临床表现。结果。大多数患者自儿童期或青春期起即具有法布雷病的典型早期表现，包括手足神经病理性疼痛（67.6%）、血管角化瘤（33.6%）、角膜涡状混浊（58.3%）、少汗（49.4%）和/或胃肠道症状（19.3%）。靶器官受累，即肾脏、心脏和脑疾病，分别在80.3%、61.0%和48.3%的患者中检出。尽管受检患者年龄相对较轻，但许多患者已出现各种疾病结局，如透析依赖性慢性肾功能衰竭（20.1%）、卒中（18.1%），包括复发性卒中，和/或严重左心室肥厚（LVH）（21.6%），伴有心律失常和/或慢性心力衰竭。随访期间死亡率为12.7%。男性患者法布雷病临床病程更为严重，并在较年轻时出现不良结局。结论。对于患有不明原因肾病或左心室肥厚和/或年轻时卒中的成年患者，应怀疑法布雷病，尤其是当这些发现伴有该病的典型早期表现时。

title: An Adaptive Wavelet–Attention Framework with Dependency-Aware Feature Modeling for Robust ECG Arrhythmia Classification
summary: Accurate identification of cardiac arrhythmias from Electrocardiogram (ECG) signals is an important element of cardiac care, especially as wearable and portable monitoring devices become more widespread. Despite advances in deep learning, the reliability of automated arrhythmia classification often declines when ECG recordings are affected by baseline drift, motion artifacts, or power-line interference. This work introduces a two-stage framework that combines adaptive ECG denoising with dependency-aware deep feature learning. The first stage, the Adaptive Threshold–Driven Time–Frequency Framework (AT-TFF), converts raw ECG signals into refined time–frequency representations using adaptive wavelet thresholding, retaining diagnostically important waveform structures while removing narrow-band and motion-induced noise. The denoised scalograms are then processed by the proposed Feature Dependency Modeling and Extraction Network (FDMENet), which combines dynamic convolutional feature extraction with a Hierarchical Shifted Dependency Attention Block to capture both local morphological detail and long-range temporal relations. The model was trained and evaluated on two public datasets, MIT-BIH Arrhythmia and PTB-XL, reaching accuracies of 96.8% and 93.5%, respectively, which exceed those of CNN, recurrent, and transformer baselines on Macro-F1, AUROC, and PR-AUC. The results show that combining adaptive signal cleaning with context-driven feature learning improves robustness and diagnostic reliability in both clinical and ambulatory ECG monitoring. Ablation and noise-robustness experiments confirm the contribution of each component.

AI.tldr: 提出自适应小波去噪与依赖感知特征学习的两阶段框架，在MIT-BIH和PTB-XL数据集上分别达到96.8%和93.5%的准确率，优于CNN、循环和Transformer基线。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴和便携监测设备普及使心电图自动心律失常分类需求增加，但基线漂移、运动伪影和电力线干扰会降低深度学习模型的可靠性，既往方法在噪声环境下鲁棒性不足。
AI.method: 研究提出两阶段框架：第一阶段AT-TFF采用自适应小波阈值将原始ECG转换为时频表示以去除窄带和运动噪声；第二阶段FDMENet结合动态卷积特征提取与分层移位依赖注意力块捕捉局部形态和长程时间关系。在MIT-BIH心律失常和PTB-XL两个公共数据集上训练评估，以Macro-F1、AUROC和PR-AUC为主要比较指标，并进行了消融和噪声鲁棒性实验。
AI.result: 模型在MIT-BIH和PTB-XL上准确率分别为96.8%和93.5%，在Macro-F1、AUROC和PR-AUC上均超过CNN、循环和Transformer基线；消融和噪声鲁棒性实验证实各组件贡献，但摘要未报告具体效应量、95%置信区间或P值。
AI.conclusion: 自适应信号清洗与上下文驱动特征学习结合可提升临床和动态心电监测中心律失常分类的鲁棒性和诊断可靠性，但研究基于公共数据集离线评估，需进一步在前瞻性临床环境中验证其泛化性和实时性。

summary_zh: 从心电图（ECG）信号中准确识别心律失常是心脏护理的重要组成部分，尤其是在可穿戴和便携式监测设备日益普及的背景下。尽管深度学习取得了进展，但当ECG记录受到基线漂移、运动伪影或电力线干扰影响时，自动心律失常分类的可靠性往往会下降。本工作提出了一种两阶段框架，将自适应ECG去噪与依赖感知的深层特征学习相结合。第一阶段，即自适应阈值驱动时频框架（AT-TFF），利用自适应小波阈值将原始ECG信号转换为精细化的时频表示，在去除窄带和运动诱发噪声的同时保留具有诊断重要性的波形结构。随后，去噪后的尺度图由所提出的特征依赖建模与提取网络（FDMENet）处理，该网络将动态卷积特征提取与分层移位依赖注意力模块相结合，以同时捕获局部形态细节和长程时间关系。该模型在两个公开数据集MIT-BIH Arrhythmia和PTB-XL上进行训练和评估，分别达到96.8%和93.5%的准确率，在Macro-F1、AUROC和PR-AUC上均超过CNN、循环和transformer基线。结果表明，将自适应信号清洗与上下文驱动的特征学习相结合，可提高临床和动态ECG监测中的稳健性和诊断可靠性。消融实验和噪声稳健性实验证实了每个组件的贡献。

title: ECG Arrhythmia Classification a Lightweight, Explainable, and Web-Deployable Deep Learning Framework Using Knowledge-Distilled GAN Features and Flask
summary: A Cardiac Arrhythmias remain a leading cause of sudden cardiac events worldwide, and timely automated screening from Electrocardiogram (ECG) signals can materially improve patient outcomes. Recent literature has explored Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) based architectures that achieve very high offline classification accuracy, but these designs are typically large, computationally heavy, and unsuitable for direct deployment in low-latency clinical or web-based settings. This work proposes an extension to that line of research: a two-stage pipeline in which a cycle-consistent generative model would be used only during the offline training phase to balance rare arrhythmia classes and to enrich the feature space, while a separate, knowledge-distilled lightweight Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) would be trained to reproduce the larger network's decision behavior using soft-label distillation. The distilled classifier is designed to be small enough to run interactively, wrapped inside a Python Flask web application that accepts a single ECG sample, returns the predicted arrhythmia class, and renders a bar chart of class-wise prediction confidence. This document presents the proposed architecture, the planned evaluation on the MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Data-base and the PTB-XL 12-lead ECG dataset, to benchmarking methodology predictions

AI.tldr: 提出一种两阶段深度学习框架，利用GAN离线增强和知识蒸馏轻量CNN，实现可解释、可网页部署的ECG心律失常分类，但尚未报告实际评估结果。
AI.motivation: 心律失常是心源性猝死的主要原因，ECG自动筛查可改善预后。现有基于GAN的分类器离线准确率高但模型庞大、计算重，难以在低延迟临床或网页环境中部署。
AI.method: 研究为方法学提案，未报告实际样本量。拟采用两阶段流程：离线训练阶段用循环一致生成模型平衡罕见心律失常类别并丰富特征空间；同时用软标签知识蒸馏训练轻量CNN以复现大网络决策。蒸馏分类器封装于Python Flask网页应用，输入单条ECG，输出预测类别及各类别置信度条形图。计划在MIT-BIH心律失常数据库和PTB-XL 12导联ECG数据集上评估。
AI.result: 摘要未报告任何实际分类性能数值（如准确率、敏感度、特异度、AUC、95%CI或P值），仅描述架构设计与评估计划。
AI.conclusion: 该框架旨在兼顾分类性能与部署可行性，为ECG心律失常筛查提供轻量、可解释的网页工具。但当前仅为提案，缺乏实证数据，其临床效用及对电生理实践的影响尚待验证。

summary_zh: 背景：心脏心律失常仍然是全球心源性猝死事件的主要原因，从心电图（ECG）信号中进行及时的自动筛查可以显著改善患者预后。近期文献探索了基于生成对抗网络（GAN）的架构，这些架构在离线分类中达到了非常高的准确率，但这些设计通常规模庞大、计算量大，不适合直接部署在低延迟的临床或基于网络的环境中。本研究提出对该研究方向进行扩展：一种两阶段流程，其中循环一致生成模型仅在离线训练阶段使用，以平衡罕见心律失常类别并丰富特征空间，而另一个经过知识蒸馏的轻量级卷积神经网络（CNN）则通过软标签蒸馏训练，以复现较大网络的决策行为。蒸馏后的分类器设计得足够小，可以交互式运行，并封装在Python Flask Web应用程序中，该程序接受单个ECG样本，返回预测的心律失常类别，并渲染类别预测置信度的条形图。本文介绍了所提出的架构、计划在MIT-BIH心律失常数据库和PTB-XL 12导联ECG数据集上进行的评估，以及基准测试方法的预测。
